This is measured as an angle in degrees around the camshaft in the distributor which controls the points, for example in a 4-cylinder engine it might be 55° (spark at 90° intervals, points closed for 55° between each).

sturdy.desc: Of firm build; stiff; stout; strong. Solid in structure or person. Foolishly obstinate or resolute; stubborn. Resolute, in a good sense; or firm, unyielding quality.

rabid.desc: Affected with rabies. Of or pertaining to rabies, or hydrophobia. Furious; raging; extremely violent. Very extreme, unreasonable, or fanatical in opinion; excessively zealous.

delusional.desc: Suffering from delusions; having false or faulty beliefs. Being, in the form of, or relating to, a delusion. A person suffering from a delusion.

unseen.desc: Not seen or discovered; invisible. ; inexperienced. Not hitherto noticed; unobserved. An examination involving material not previously seen or studied.

loosen.desc: To make loose. To become loose. To disengage (a device that restrains). To become unfastened or undone.

sibling.desc: A person who shares a parent; one's brother or sister who one shares a parent with. A node in a data structure that shares its parent with another node. The most closely related species, or one of several most closely related species when none can be determined to be more closely related.

cursing.desc: The act of one who curses.

armor.desc: A protective layer over a body, vehicle, or other object intended to deflect or diffuse damaging forces. A natural form of this kind of protection on an animal's body. A metal plate, protecting a ship, military vehicle, or aircraft. A tank, or other heavy mobile assault vehicle.

oversized.desc: Very large; especially of something larger than normal for its type.

dirt.desc: Soil or earth. A stain or spot (on clothes etc); any foreign substance that worsens appearance. Previously unknown facts or rumors about a person. Meanness; sordidness.

askew.desc: Turned or twisted to one side. Untoward, unfavourable. Tilted to one side.

tread.desc: To step or walk (on or across something); to trample. To step or walk upon. To proceed, to behave (in a certain manner). To beat or press with the feet.

plead.desc: To present (an argument or a plea), especially in a legal case. To beg, beseech, or implore, especially emotionally. To offer by way of excuse. To discuss by arguments.

pronouncement.desc: An official public announcement. An utterance.

mess.desc: A thing or group of things in a disagreeable, disorganised, or dirty state; hence a bad situation. A large quantity or number. Excrement. A person in a state of (especially emotional) turmoil or disarray; an emotional wreck.

cafeteria.desc: A restaurant in which customers select their food at a counter then carry it on a tray to a table to eat. A dining area in an institution where meals may be purchased (as above), provided, or brought in from elsewhere.

polite.desc: Well-mannered, civilized. Smooth, polished, burnished. To polish; to refine; to render polite.

fortify.desc: To undergo, or cause to undergo, fortition.

gait.desc: A manner of walking or stepping; a bearing or carriage while moving on legs. One of the distinct patterns of locomotion exhibited by a horse, occurring either naturally or as a result of training. To teach a specific gait to a horse. A sheaf of corn.

hump.desc: A mound of earth. A speed bump or speed hump. A deformity in humans caused by abnormal curvature of the upper spine. A rounded fleshy mass, such as on a camel or zebu.

rumor.desc: A statement or claim of questionable accuracy, from no known reliable source, usually spread by word of mouth. Information or misinformation of the kind contained in such claims. Report, news, information in general. Fame, reputation.

remnant.desc: A small portion remaining of a larger thing or group; part of a former whole. The remaining fabric at the end of the bolt. An unsold end of piece goods, as cloth, ribbons, carpets, etc. The passionate, influential minority of radicals in a faction or party.

coward.desc: A person who lacks courage. Cowardly. Borne in the escutcheon with his tail doubled between his legs. To intimidate.

bare.desc: Minimal; that is or are just sufficient. Naked, uncovered. Having no supplies. Having no decoration.

awe.desc: A feeling of fear and reverence. A feeling of amazement. Power to inspire awe. To inspire fear and reverence in.

lie.desc: To rest in a horizontal position on a surface. To be placed or situated. To abide; to remain for a longer or shorter time; to be in a certain state or condition. ''Used with'' '''': to be or exist; to belong or pertain; to have an abiding place; to consist.

sympathize.desc: To have, show or express sympathy; to be affected by feelings similar to those of another, in consequence of knowing the person to be thus affected To support, favour, have sympathy (''with'' a political cause or movement, a side in a conflict / ''in'' an action). To say in an expression of sympathy. To have a common feeling, as of bodily pleasure or pain.

grieve.desc: To cause sorrow or distress to. To feel very sad about; to mourn; to sorrow for. To experience grief. To harm.

excuse.desc: To forgive; to pardon; to overlook. To allow to leave, or release from any obligation. To provide an excuse for; to justify. To relieve of an imputation by apology or defense; to make apology for as not seriously evil; to ask pardon or indulgence for.

glove.desc: An item of clothing, covering all or part of the hand and fingers, but usually allowing independent movement of the fingers. A baseball mitt. The ability to catch a hit ball. A condom.

vibration.desc: The act of vibrating or the condition of being vibrated. Any periodic process, especially a rapid linear motion of a body about an equilibrium position. A single complete vibrating motion. A vibrational energy of spiritual nature through which mediumistic and other paranormal phenomena are conveyed or affected.

brunette.desc: Of a brown color or tone. Having brown hair. A person, especially female, with brown hair.

barn.desc: A building, often found on a farm, used for storage or keeping animals such as cattle. A unit of surface area equal to 10−28 square metres. An arena. A warm and cozy place, especially a bedroom; a roost.

presume.desc: To be so presumptuous as (to do something) without proper authority or permission . To perform, do (something) without authority; to lay claim to without permission. To assume or suggest to be true (without proof); to take for granted, to suppose. To take as a premise; to assume for the sake of argument.

listen.desc: To use one's sense of hearing and auditory cognition in an intentional way; to make deliberate use of one's ears; to pay attention to or wait for a specific sound. To accept advice or obey instruction; to agree or assent. An instance of listening.

slope.desc: A surface that either inclines or declines in a regular manner from the perspective of an observer. An area of ground that tends evenly upward or downward. The degree to which a surface tends upward or downward. The ratio of the vertical and horizontal distances between two points lying on the line.

taint.desc: A ,  or , especially in . A tinge, trace or touch. A mark of , especially on one's ; blemish. Tincture; hue; colour.

callous.desc: Emotionally hardened; unfeeling and indifferent to the suffering/feelings of others. Having calluses, or relating to calluses. . .

collarbone.desc: The bone joining the shoulder and the breastbone.

sack.desc: A bag; especially a large bag of strong, coarse material for storage and handling of various commodities, such as potatoes, coal, coffee; or, a bag with handles used at a supermarket, a grocery sack; or, a small bag for small items, a satchel. The amount a sack holds; also, an archaic or historical measure of varying capacity, depending on commodity type and according to local usage; an old English measure of weight, usually of wool, equal to 13 stone (182 pounds), or in other sources, 26 stone (364 pounds). The plunder and pillaging of a captured town or city. Loot or booty obtained by pillage.

ribbon.desc: A long, narrow strip of material used for decoration of clothing or the hair or gift wrapping. An awareness ribbon. An inked strip of material against which type is pressed to print letters in a typewriter or printer. A narrow strip or shred.

vein.desc: A blood vessel that transports blood from the capillaries back to the heart. The entrails of a shrimp. In leaves, a thickened portion of the leaf containing the vascular bundle. The nervure of an insect’s wing.

mirror.desc: A smooth surface, usually made of glass with reflective material painted on the underside, that reflects light so as to give an image of what is in front of it. An object, person, or event that reflects or gives a picture of another. A website or server that contains replicated data from another site. A mirror carp.

grandmother.desc: A mother of someone's parent. A female ancestor or progenitor. In Amazonian shamanism and related contexts, a reverential name for the ayahuasca vine or brew, symbolizing its role as a wise, guiding spirit.

gesture.desc: A motion of the limbs or body, especially one made to emphasize speech. An act or a remark that serves as a formality or as a sign of attitude. A motion made with a pointing device, or on a touchscreen, that is recognised by the system as a command. The manner of carrying the body; position of the body or limbs; posture.

impenetrable.desc: Not penetrable. Opaque; obscure; not translucent or transparent. Incomprehensible; fathomless; inscrutable. A person not openly given to friendship.

unspoken.desc: Not spoken; not said. Not formally articulated or stated; implicit or understood.

treasure.desc: A collection of valuable things; accumulated wealth; a stock of money, jewels, ''etc.'' Anything greatly valued. To consider to be precious; to value highly. To store or stow in a safe place.

neat.desc: Clean, tidy; free from dirt or impurities. Free from contaminants; unadulterated, undiluted. Particularly of liquor and cocktails; see usage below. Conditions with a liquid reagent or gas performed with no standard solvent or cosolvent. With all deductions or allowances made; net.

ape.desc: An anthropoid of the superfamily , generally larger than monkeys and distinguished from them by having no tail. A Hominoidea primate other than a human. An unintelligent or unsophisticated person, especially one who behaves irrationally or in an uncivilised manner. One who apes; a foolish imitator.

coin.desc: A piece of currency, usually metallic and in the shape of a disc, but sometimes polygonal, or with a hole in the middle. A token used in a special establishment like a casino. That which serves for payment or recompense. Something in broad circulation or use.

unconcerned.desc: Indifferent and having no interest; aloof. Not anxious, apprehensive, or worried. Having no involvement.

kindness.desc: The state of being kind. An instance of kind or charitable behaviour.

ridiculous.desc: Deserving of ridicule; foolish, absurd. , extreme, unbelievable.

pear.desc: An edible fruit produced by the pear tree, similar to an apple but typically elongated towards the stem. A type of fruit tree (). The wood of the pear tree (pearwood, pear wood). Choke pear (a torture device).

quirk.desc: An idiosyncrasy; a slight glitch, a mannerism; something unusual about the manner or style of something or someone. An acute angle dividing a molding; a groove that runs lengthwise between the upper part of a molding and a soffit. A quibble, evasion, or subterfuge. To (cause to) move with a wry jerk.

headquarter.desc: To provide (an organization) with headquarters. To establish headquarters.

baggy.desc: Of clothing, very loose-fitting, so as to hang away from the body. Of or relating to a British music genre of the 1980s and 1990s, influenced by Madchester and psychedelia and associated with baggy clothing. Of writing, etc.: overwrought; flabby; having too much padding. A member of the 1980/90s British music and fashion movement.

wolf.desc: ; the largest wild member of the canine subfamily. A man who makes amorous advances to many women. A wolf tone or wolf note. Any very ravenous, rapacious, or destructive person or thing; especially, want; starvation.

mask.desc: A cover, or partial cover, for the face, used for disguise or protection. That which disguises; a pretext or subterfuge. Appearance, likeness. A festive entertainment of dancing or other diversions, where all wear masks; a masquerade.

bereft.desc: Pained by the loss of someone. Deprived of, stripped of, robbed of. Lacking, devoid of.

bombard.desc: A medieval primitive cannon, used chiefly in sieges for throwing heavy stone balls. A bassoon-like medieval musical instrument. A large liquor container made of leather, in the form of a jug or a bottle. A bombardment.

haste.desc: Speed; swiftness; dispatch. Urgency; sudden excitement of feeling or passion; precipitance; vehemence. To urge onward; to hasten. To move with haste.

glossy.desc: Having a smooth, silklike, reflective () surface. Attention-grabbing and superficially attractive. A glossy magazine. A glossy photograph.

obey.desc: To do as ordered by (a person, institution etc), to act according to the bidding of. To do as one is told. To be obedient, compliant (to a given law, restriction etc.).

clam.desc: A bivalve mollusk of many kinds, especially those that are edible; for example  (), hard clams (), sea clams or hen clams (), and other species, possibly originally applied to clams of species , a huge East Indian bivalve. A type of strong pincers or forceps. A kind of vise, usually of wood. A dollar.

heal.desc: To make better from a disease, wound, etc.; to revive or cure. To become better or healthy again. To reconcile, as a breach or difference; to make whole; to free from guilt. A spell or ability that restores hit points or removes a status ailment.

oddly.desc: In a peculiar manner; strangely; unusually. In a manner measured by an odd number.

click.desc: A brief, sharp, not particularly loud, relatively high-pitched sound produced by the impact of something small and hard against something hard, such as by the operation of a switch, a lock or a latch. The act of snapping one's fingers. An ingressive sound made by coarticulating a velar or uvular closure with another closure. The sound made by a dolphin.

swam.desc: The word 'swam' and its common associations.

retract.desc: To draw back; to draw up; to withdraw. An act of retracting or withdrawing (a mistake, a statement, etc.); a retraction. A pulling back, especially  of an army or military troops; a pull-back, a retreat; also, a signal for this to be done. A subgroup of a given group such that there is a surjective endomorphism from the ambient group to the subgroup which is constant on the subgroup; in this case the subgroup is a ''retract of the ambient group''. In symbols: H in G is a ''retract of'' G if there exists a surjective homomorphism \sigma from G to H with \sigma|_H = \operatorname{id}.

filth.desc: Dirt; foul matter; that which soils or defiles. Smut; that which sullies or defiles the moral character; corruption; pollution. A vile or disgusting person. Weeds growing on pasture land.

credential.desc: Pertaining to or serving as an introduction or recommendation (to someone). documentary or electronic evidence that a person has certain status or privileges Evidence of skill or excellence. to furnish with credentials

lunchtime.desc: The time or hour at or around which lunch is normally eaten. A break in work or school to eat lunch.

relieve.desc: To ease (a person, person's thoughts etc.) from mental distress; to stop (someone) feeling anxious or worried, to alleviate the distress of. To ease (someone, a part of the body etc.) or give relief from physical pain or discomfort. To alleviate (pain, distress, mental discomfort etc.). To provide comfort or assistance to (someone in need, especially in poverty).

languish.desc: To lose strength and become weak; to be in a state of weakness or sickness. To pine away in longing for something; to have low spirits, especially from lovesickness. To live in miserable or disheartening conditions. To be neglected; to make little progress, be unsuccessful.

feverish.desc: Having a fever, an elevated body temperature. Filled with excess energy. Morbidly eager.

vent.desc: An opening through which gases, especially air, can pass. A small aperture. An opening in a volcano from which lava or gas flows. A rant; a long session of expressing verbal frustration.

khaki.desc: A dull, yellowish-brown colour, the colour of dust. Khaki green, a dull green colour. A strong cloth of wool or cotton, often used for military or other uniforms. A soldier wearing a khaki uniform.

ascend.desc: To move upward, to fly, to soar. To slope in an upward direction. To go up. To succeed a ruler on (the throne).

distaste.desc: A feeling of dislike, aversion or antipathy. Aversion of the taste; dislike, as of food or drink; disrelish. Discomfort; uneasiness. Alienation of affection; displeasure; anger.

bonfire.desc: A large, controlled outdoor fire lit to celebrate something or as a signal. A fire lit outdoors to burn unwanted items; originally , heretics or other offenders, or banned books; now, generally agricultural or garden waste, or rubbish. Something like a bonfire ''(sense 1 or 2)'' in heat, destructiveness, ferocity, etc. A fire lit to cremate a dead body; a funeral pyre.

waitress.desc: A female attendant who serves customers in a restaurant, café, or similar. To work as a waitress.

elephant.desc: A large mammal of the family  in the order , having a trunk, and native to Africa and Asia. Anything huge and ponderous. . Ivory.

fragment.desc: A part broken off; a small, detached portion; an imperfect part, either physically or not. A sentence not containing a subject or a predicate; a sentence fragment. An incomplete portion of code. A portion of a URL referring to a subordinate resource or  (such as a specific point on a web page), introduced by the # sign.

sidewalk.desc: A paved footpath located at the side of a road, for the use of pedestrians. Any paved footpath, even if not located at the side of a road.

socialize.desc: To interact with others, especially personally, informally and off the clock rather than formally and officially. To instruct (somebody), usually subconsciously and mostly by example, in the etiquette of a society. To take something into collective or governmental ownership.

beneath.desc: Below or underneath. Below. In a position that is lower in rank, dignity, etc. Covered up or concealed by something.

traitor.desc: Someone who violates an allegiance and betrays their country; someone guilty of treason; one who, in breach of trust, delivers their country to an enemy, or yields up any fort or place entrusted to their defense, or surrenders an army or body of troops to the enemy, unless when vanquished. Someone who takes arms and levies war against their country; or one who aids an enemy in conquering their country. One who betrays any confidence or trust. To act the traitor toward; to betray; to deceive.

overlook.desc: A vista or point that gives a view down toward something else. To offer a view (of something) from a higher position. To fail to notice; to look over and beyond (anything) without seeing it. To pretend not to have noticed (something, especially a mistake or flaw); to pass over (something) without censure or punishment.

bleach.desc: A chemical, such as sodium hypochlorite or hydrogen peroxide, or a preparation of such a chemical, used for disinfecting or whitening. A variety of bleach. To treat with bleach, especially so as to whiten (fabric, paper, etc.) or lighten (hair). To be whitened or lightened (by the sun, for example).

quietly.desc: Producing little or no noise. Without attracting attention.

sway.desc: The act of swaying; a swaying motion; a swing or sweep of a weapon. A rocking or swinging motion. Influence, weight, or authority that inclines to one side Preponderance; turn or cast of balance.

jealous.desc: Suspecting rivalry in love; troubled by worries that one might have been replaced in someone's affections; suspicious of a lover's or spouse's fidelity. Protective; zealously guarding; careful in the protection of something (or someone) one has or appreciates, especially one's spouse or lover. Envious; feeling resentful or angered toward someone for a perceived advantage or success, material or otherwise. Suspicious; apprehensive.

sadness.desc: The state or emotion of being sad. An event in one's life that causes sadness.

peel.desc: To remove the skin or outer covering of. To remove something from the outer or top layer of. To become detached, come away, especially in flakes or strips; to shed skin in such a way. To remove one's clothing.

warn.desc: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); ''especially:'' To caution or admonish (someone) against unwise or unacceptable behaviour. To advise or order to go or stay away. To give warning.

relax.desc: To make something loose. To become loose. To relieve (someone or someone's mind) of stress; to enable to rest; to calm down. To rest and become relieved of stress.

discard.desc: To throw away, to reject. To make a discard; to throw out a card. To dismiss from employment, confidence, or favour; to discharge. Anything discarded.

taper.desc: A slender wax candle. A small light. A tapering form; gradual diminution of thickness and/or cross section in an elongated object. The portion of an object with such a form.

scary.desc: Causing fear or anxiety Uncannily striking or surprising. Subject to sudden alarm; easily frightened. To a scary extent; scarily.

unwind.desc: To separate (something that is wound up) To disentangle To relax; to chill out; to rest and become relieved of stress To be or become unwound; to be capable of being unwound or untwisted.

fog.desc: A thick cloud that forms near the ground; the obscurity of such a cloud. A mist or film clouding a surface. A state of mind characterized by lethargy and confusion. A silver deposit or other blur on a negative or developed photographic image.

bum.desc: An act of anal sex. To sodomize; to engage in anal sex. A homeless person, usually a man. A lazy, incompetent, or annoying person, usually a man.

corpse.desc: A dead body, especially that of a human as opposed to an animal. The dead body of any animal with flesh; the dead body of a vertebrate; a carcass. A human body in general, whether living or dead. To laugh uncontrollably during a performance.

coat.desc: An outer garment covering the upper torso and arms. A covering of material, such as paint. The fur or feathers covering an animal's skin. Canvas painted with thick tar and secured round a mast or bowsprit to prevent water running down the sides into the hold (now made of rubber or leather).

pointless.desc: Having no point or sharp tip; terminating squarely or in a rounded end. Having no prominent or important feature, as of an argument, discourse, etc. Having no purpose; purposeless; unable to effect an aim. Having no points

greedy.desc: Having greed; consumed by selfish desires. Prone to overeat. Tending to match as much text as possible. That tries to find the global optimum by finding the local optimum at each stage.

hesitation.desc: An act of hesitating Doubt; vacillation. A faltering in speech; stammering.

cloud.desc: A visible mass of water droplets suspended in the air. Any mass of dust, steam or smoke resembling such a mass. Anything which makes things foggy or gloomy. Anything unsubstantial.

nest.desc: A structure built by a bird as a place to incubate eggs and rear young. A place used by a mammal, fish, amphibian or insect, for depositing eggs and hatching young. A snug, comfortable, or cosy residence or job situation. A retreat, or place of habitual resort.

spider.desc: Any of various eight-legged, predatory arthropods, of the order , most of which spin webs to catch prey. A program which follows links on the World Wide Web in order to gather information. A float  made by mixing ice-cream and a soda or fizzy drink (such as lemonade). An alcoholic drink made with brandy and lemonade or ginger beer.

trepidation.desc: Anxiety over the uncertain future or possible ill-occurrence. An involuntary trembling, sometimes an effect of paralysis, but usually caused by terror or fear. A libration of the starry sphere in the Ptolemaic system; a motion ascribed to the firmament, to account for certain small changes in the position of the ecliptic and of the stars.

morbid.desc: Of, relating to, or afflicted by disease. Taking an interest in, or fixating on, unhealthy or unwholesome subjects such as death, decay, disease. Suggesting the horror of death; macabre or ghoulish. Grisly or gruesome.

gentle.desc: and amiable; of a considerate or kindly disposition. and mild rather than hard or severe. and easily managed. rather than steep or sudden.

nameless.desc: Not having a name. Whose name is unknown; unidentified or obscured. Unable to be described or expressed. Illegitimate.

dislodge.desc: To remove or force out from a position or dwelling previously occupied. To move or go from a dwelling or former position. To force out of a secure or settled position.

odor.desc: Any smell, whether fragrant or offensive. A strong, pervasive quality. Esteem. Something which produces a scent; incense, a perfume.

thunderous.desc: Very loud; that sounds like thunder; thundersome. Also in metaphorical expressions, signifying fury.

pasture.desc: Land, specifically, an open field, on which livestock is kept for feeding. Ground covered with grass or herbage, used or suitable for the grazing of livestock. Food, nourishment. To move animals into a pasture.

windshield.desc: A transparent screen made of glass, located at the front and back of a vehicle in front of its occupants to protect them from the wind force generated by the vehicle's speed and inclement weather. A cover for a microphone to exclude airy noises such as wind and breathing. A lightweight aerodynamic fairing mounted on the nose of an armor-piercing shell to reduce drag and increase range. To install a windshield on.

delicious.desc: Pleasing to the sense of taste; tasty. Pleasing to a person's taste; pleasing to the eyes or mind. Having tremendous sex appeal.

knit.desc: To turn thread or yarn into a piece of fabric by forming loops that are pulled through each other. This can be done by hand with needles or by machine. To create a stitch by pulling the working yarn through an existing stitch from back to front. To join closely and firmly together. To become closely and firmly joined; become compacted.

hungry.desc: Affected by hunger; having the physical need for food. Causing hunger. Eager; having an avid desire or appetite for something. Not rich or fertile; poor; barren; starved.

impatient.desc: Restless, short of temper, and intolerant of delays. Anxious and eager, especially to begin or have something. Not to be borne; unendurable. Prompted by, or exhibiting, impatience.

compose.desc: To make something by merging parts. To make up the whole; to constitute. To comprise. To construct by mental labor; to think up; particularly, to produce or create a literary or musical work.

desolate.desc: Deserted and devoid of inhabitants. Barren and lifeless. Made unfit for habitation or use because of neglect, destruction etc. Dismal or dreary.

plaid.desc: A type of twilled woollen cloth, often with a tartan or chequered pattern. A length of such material used as a piece of clothing, formerly worn in the Scottish Highlands and other parts of northern Britain and remaining as an item of ceremonial dress worn by members of Scottish pipe bands. The typical chequered pattern of a plaid; tartan. Having a pattern or colors which resemble a Scottish tartan; checkered or marked with bars or stripes at right angles to one another.

invite.desc: To ask for the presence or participation of someone or something. To request formally. To encourage. To allure; to draw to; to tempt to come; to induce by pleasure or hope; to attract.

sting.desc: A bump left on the skin after having been stung. A puncture made by an insect or arachnid in an attack, usually including the injection of venom. A pointed portion of an insect or arachnid used for attack. A sharp, localized pain primarily on the epidermis.

canopy.desc: A high cover providing shelter, such as a cloth supported above an object, particularly over a bed. Any overhanging or projecting roof structure, typically over entrances or doors. The zone of the highest foliage and branches of a forest. In an airplane, the transparent cockpit cover.

candlelight.desc: The light emitted by a candle. The evening, when darkness falls and it is time to light candles.

contemplate.desc: To look at on all sides or in all its aspects; to view or consider with continued attention; to regard with deliberate care; to meditate on; to study, ponder, or consider. To consider as a possibility.

shave.desc: To make (the head, skin etc.) bald or (the hair) shorter by using a tool such as a razor or electric clippers to cut the hair close to the skin. To cut anything in this fashion. To remove hair from one's face by this means. To cut finely, for example slices of meat.

pungent.desc: Having a strong odor that stings the nose; . Having a strong taste that stings the tongue; . Stinging; acerbic. Having a sharp and stiff point.

whisk.desc: A quick, light sweeping motion. A kitchen utensil, now usually made from stiff wire loops fixed to a handle (and formerly of twigs), used for whipping (or a mechanical device with the same function). A bunch of twigs, hair, etc., used as a brush. A small handheld broom with a small (or no) handle.

handsome.desc: Having a pleasing appearance, good-looking, attractive, particularly: Good, appealing, appropriate. Generous or noble in character. Ample; moderately large.

dreary.desc: Drab; dark, colorless, or cheerless. Grievous, dire; appalling. A dreary person or thing.

cloth.desc: A fabric, usually made of woven, knitted, or felted fibres or filaments, such as used in dressing, decorating, cleaning or other practical use. Sometimes, woven fabric specifically. Specifically, a tablecloth, especially as spread before a meal or removed afterwards. A piece of cloth used for a particular purpose. Substance or essence; the whole of something complex.

elude.desc: To evade or escape from (someone or something), especially by using cunning or skill. To shake off (a pursuer); to give someone the slip. To escape being understandable to; to be incomprehensible to. To escape someone's memory, to slip someone's mind.

nightmare.desc: A very unpleasant or frightening dream. Any bad, miserable, difficult or terrifying situation or experience that arouses anxiety, terror, agony or great displeasure. A demon or monster, thought to plague people while they slept and cause a feeling of suffocation and terror during sleep. A feeling of extreme anxiety or suffocation experienced during sleep; sleep paralysis.

typewriter.desc: A device, at least partially mechanical, used to print text by pressing keys that cause type to be impressed through an inked ribbon onto paper. One who uses a typewriter; a typist. A machine gun or submachine gun (from the noise it makes when firing). A prank in which fingers are jabbed roughly onto someone's chest followed by striking them over the ear in imitation of using an old-fashioned typewriter.

anyway.desc: Regardless; anyhow. . See anyhow and at least. In any way.

teasing.desc: The act of harassing someone playfully or maliciously, especially by ridicule; provoking someone with persistent annoyances; making fun of, making light of someone. The act of removing tangles from one's hair with a comb. vexing, especially by ridicule. Arousing sexual desire without intending to satisfy it.

irritation.desc: The act of irritating or annoying. The state of being irritated. A thing or person that annoys. A state of inflammation or of painful reaction to cell or tissue damage.

emit.desc: To send out or give off. To come out, to be sent out or given off. To result in specific machine instructions or bytecode when compiled. To produce specific computer code when processed or executed.

wonder.desc: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence. Something that causes amazement or awe; a marvel. A mental pondering, a thought. A kind of donut; a cruller.

woe.desc: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness. Calamity, trouble. A curse; a malediction. Woeful; sorrowful

laundry.desc: A laundering; a washing. A place or room where laundering is done - including, by extension, other forms of laundering than clothes washing. That which needs to be, is being, or has been laundered. A penalty flag.

orchestrate.desc: To arrange or score music for performance by an orchestra. To compose or arrange orchestral music for a dramatic performance. To arrange or direct diverse elements to achieve a desired effect

flimsy.desc: Likely to bend or break under pressure; easily damaged; frail, unsubstantial. A thing which is ill-founded, unconvincing, or weak. Thin typing paper used together with carbon paper in a typewriter to make multiple copies of a document;  a sheet of such paper. A document printed or typed on such paper.

elegantly.desc: , smoothly, and swiftly; with supreme style.

pavement.desc: A paved surface; a hard covering on the ground. A paved path, for the use of pedestrians, located at the side of a road. A paving (paved part) of a road or other thoroughfare; the roadway or road surface. The paved part of an area other than a road or sidewalk, such as a cobblestone plaza, asphalt schoolyard or playground, or parking lot.

robot.desc: A system of serfdom used in Central Europe, under which a tenant's rent was paid in forced labour. An intelligent mechanical being designed to look like a human or other creature, and usually made from metal. A machine built to carry out some complex task or group of tasks by physically moving, especially one which can be programmed. A bot, software designed to perform a task.

dot.desc: A small, round spot. A punctuation mark used to indicate the end of a sentence or an abbreviated part of a word; a full stop; a period. A point used as a diacritical mark above or below various letters of the Latin script, as in Ȧ, Ạ, Ḅ, Ḃ, Ċ. A symbol used for separating the fractional part of a decimal number from the whole part, for indicating multiplication or a scalar product, or for various other purposes.

sedate.desc: Of a person or animal, or their behaviour: calm and composed (often in a dignified manner), and avoiding or unaffected by activity or excitement. To give (a person) a sedative to calm them or put them to sleep; to tranquilize. To make (someone or something) calm or tranquil; to assuage, to calm, to soothe.

bearded.desc: Having a beard; involving a beard. Having a fringe or appendage resembling a beard in some way (''often followed by'' with). Of an axe: having the lower portion of the axehead extending the cutting edge significantly below the width of the butt, thus providing a wide cutting surface while keeping overall weight low. Having a beard (or similar appendage) of a specified type.

skip.desc: To move by hopping on alternate feet. To leap about lightly. To skim, ricochet or bounce over a surface. To throw (something), making it skim, ricochet, or bounce over a surface.

unworthy.desc: Not worthy; lacking value or merit; worthless. An inadequate person.

instantly.desc: At once; without delay. Urgently; with insistence. At the same time. As soon as, directly.

rejoice.desc: To be very happy, be delighted, exult; to feel joy. To have (someone) as a lover or spouse; to enjoy sexually. To make happy, exhilarate. To enjoy.

embarrass.desc: To disrupt someone's composure or comfort with acting publicly or freely. To hinder from liberty of movement; to impede; to obstruct. To involve in difficulties concerning money matters; to encumber with debt; to beset with urgent claims or demands. To perplex mentally; confuse, disconcert; catch off guard.

ceiling.desc: The overhead closure of a room. The upper limit of an object or action. The highest altitude at which an aircraft can safely maintain flight. The measurement of visible distance from ground or sea level to an overcast cloud cover; under a clear sky, the ceiling measurement is identified as "unlimited."

wasteland.desc: A place with no remaining resources; a desert. Any barren or uninteresting place. A devastated, uninhabitable area. Unused land.

cubicle.desc: A small separate part or one of the compartments of a room, ''especially'' in a work environment. A small enclosure at a swimming pool etc. used to provide personal privacy when changing. A small enclosure in a public toilet for individual use.

skinned.desc: Having skin. Covered in a thin membrane resembling skin. Having skin (or similar outer layer) totally or partially removed. Stripped of money or property.

rotate.desc: To spin, turn, or revolve. To advance through a sequence; to take turns. To lift the nose during takeoff, just prior to liftoff. To spin, turn, or revolve something.

skeleton.desc: The system that provides support to an organism, where in vertebrates it is internal and consists of bones and cartilage, and external in some other animals. An anthropomorphic representation of a skeleton. A very thin person. The central core of something that gives shape to the entire structure; an outline of a longer project.

gigantic.desc: Very large. Excellent; very good or exciting. In the manner of a giant.

kid.desc: A child, adolescent or  a young adult. A young goat. A young antelope. A deception; an act of kidding somebody.

someday.desc: Sometime; at some unspecified time in the future.

gum.desc: The flesh around the teeth. To chew, especially of a toothless person or animal. To deepen and enlarge the spaces between the teeth of (a worn saw), as with a gummer. A viscous water-soluble carbohydrate exudate of certain plants that hardens when it becomes dry, or such a substance as a component of a plant exudate.

desk.desc: A table, frame, or case, in past centuries usually with a sloping top but now usually with a flat top, for the use of writers and readers. It often has a drawer or repository underneath. A reading table or lectern to support the book from which the liturgical service is read, differing from the pulpit from which the sermon is preached; also (especially in the United States), a pulpit. Hence, used symbolically for the clerical profession. A department tasked with a particular topic or focus in certain types of businesses, such as newspapers and financial trading firms. .

mash.desc: A mass of mixed ingredients reduced to a soft pulpy state by beating or pressure; a mass of anything in a soft pulpy state. Ground or bruised malt, or meal of rye, wheat, corn, or other grain (or a mixture of malt and meal) steeped and stirred in hot water for making the wort. Mashed potatoes. A mixture of meal or bran and water fed to animals.

boil.desc: A localized accumulation of pus in the skin, resulting from infection. The point at which fluid begins to change to a vapour; the boiling point. An instance of boiling. A dish of boiled food, especially seafood.

exhaustion.desc: The point of complete depletion, of the state of being used up. Supreme tiredness; having exhausted energy. The removal (by percolation etc) of an active medicinal constituent from plant material. The removal of all air from a vessel (the creation of a vacuum).

poison.desc: A substance that is harmful or lethal to a living organism when ingested. Anything harmful to a person or thing. An alcoholic drink. (Mainly in the phrases "name your poison" and "what's your poison?") Any substance that inhibits catalytic activity.

instinctive.desc: Related to or prompted by instinct. Driven by impulse, spontaneous and without thinking.

impulsive.desc: Having the power of driving or impelling; giving an impulse; moving; impellent. Actuated by impulse or by transient feelings; inclined to make rapid decisions without due consideration. Of a force, acting momentarily, or by impulse; not continuous. That which impels or gives an impulse; an impelling agent.

reciprocate.desc: To exchange two things, with both parties giving one thing and taking another thing. To give something else in response (where the "thing" may also be abstract, a feeling or action) To make a reciprocal gift. To move backwards and forwards, like a piston. To counter, retort or retaliate.

flash.desc: To cause to shine briefly or intermittently. To blink; to shine or illuminate intermittently. To be visible briefly. To make visible briefly.

heck.desc: Hell. Hell. to break, to destroy to mess up

profess.desc: To administer the vows of a religious order to (someone); to admit to a religious order. To declare oneself (to be something). To declare; to assert, affirm. To make a claim (to be something); to lay claim to (a given quality, feeling etc.), often with connotations of insincerity.

wet.desc: Made up of liquid or moisture, usually (but not always) water. Of an object, etc.: covered or impregnated with liquid, usually (but not always) water. Of a burrito, sandwich, or other food: covered in a sauce. Of calligraphy and fountain pens: depositing a large amount of ink from the nib or the feed.

delusion.desc: An adamant belief in a falsehood despite incontestable evidence. The state of being deluded or misled, or process of deluding somebody. That which is falsely or delusively believed or propagated; false belief; error in belief. A strong belief contrary to evidence.

earnestly.desc: In an earnest manner; being very sincere; putting forth genuine effort.

insistent.desc: Standing or resting on something. Urgent in dwelling upon anything; persistent in urging or maintaining. Extorting attention or notice; coercively staring or prominent; vivid; intense. Standing on end: specifically said of the hind toe of a bird when its base is inserted so high on the shank that only its tip touches the ground: correlated with incumbent.

compulsion.desc: An irrational need or irresistible urge to perform some action, often despite negative consequences. The use of authority, influence, or other power to force (compel) a person or persons to act. The lawful use of violence (i.e. by the administration).

cart.desc: A small, open, wheeled vehicle, drawn or pushed by a person or animal, often with two wheels on one axle, more often used for transporting goods than passengers. A small motor vehicle resembling a car; a go-cart. A shopping cart. To carry or convey in a cart.

spin.desc: To rotate, revolve, gyrate (usually quickly); to partially or completely rotate to face another direction. To make yarn by twisting and winding fibers together. To present, describe, or interpret, or to introduce a bias or slant, so as to give something a favorable or advantageous appearance. To make the ball move sideways when it bounces on the pitch.

coffin.desc: A closed box in which the body of a dead person is placed for burial. The eighth Lenormand card. A casing or crust, or a mold, of pastry, as for a pie. A conical paper bag, used by grocers.

perfume.desc: A pleasant smell; the scent, odor, or odoriferous particles emitted from a sweet-smelling substance; a pleasant odor. A substance created to provide a pleasant smell or one which emits an agreeable odor. To apply perfume to; to fill or impregnate with a perfume; to scent.

wax.desc: Beeswax. Earwax. Any oily, water-resistant, solid or semisolid substance; normally long-chain hydrocarbons, alcohols or esters. Any preparation containing wax, used as a polish.

pulse.desc: A beat or throb; also, a repeated sequence of such beats or throbs. The focus of energy or vigour of an activity, place, or thing; also, the feeling of bustle, busyness, or energy in a place; the heartbeat. An (increased) amount of a substance (such as a drug or an isotopic label) given over a short time. A setting on a food processor which causes it to work in a series of short bursts rather than continuously, in order to break up ingredients without liquidizing them; also, a use of this setting.

mischievous.desc: Causing mischief; injurious. Troublesome, cheeky, badly behaved, impish, naughty, disobedient; showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way and liking to have fun by playing harmless tricks on people or doing things they are not supposed to do.

joke.desc: An amusing story. Something said or done for amusement, not in seriousness. A laughably worthless thing or person; a sham. Something that is far easier or far less challenging than expected.

trick.desc: Something designed to fool, dupe, outsmart, mislead or swindle. A single element of a magician's (or any variety entertainer's) act; a magic trick. An entertaining difficult physical action. An effective, clever or quick way of doing something.

pretense.desc: The action of pretending; false or simulated show or appearance; false or hypocritical assertion or representation. Affectation or ostentation of manner. Intention or purpose not real but professed. An unsupported claim made or implied.

steely.desc: Having qualities resembling those of steel, especially hardness and resoluteness. Made of steel.

tarp.desc: . To cover something with a tarpaulin.

excitement.desc: The state of being excited (emotionally aroused). Something that excites.

ponder.desc: To wonder, think of deeply. To consider (something) carefully and thoroughly. To weigh. A period of deep thought.

feeble.desc: Deficient in physical strength. Lacking force, vigor, or effectiveness in action or expression; faint. To make feeble; to enfeeble.

proclaim.desc: To announce or declare. To make (something) the subject of an official proclamation bringing it within the scope of emergency powers.

denim.desc: A textile often made of cotton with a distinct diagonal pattern.

parlor.desc: The living room of a house, or a room for entertaining guests; a room for talking; a sitting-room or drawing room. The apartment in a monastery or nunnery where the residents are permitted to meet and converse with each other or with visitors from the outside. A comfortable room in a public house. A covered open-air patio.

muddy.desc: Covered or splashed with, or full of, . Of water or some other liquid: containing mud or  other sediment in suspension; cloudy, turbid. Of or relating to mud; also, having the characteristics of mud, especially in colour or taste. Soiled with feces.

mischief.desc: Conduct that playfully causes petty annoyance. A playfully annoying action. A group or a pack of rats. Harm or injury:

duck.desc: To quickly lower (the head or body), often in order to prevent it from being struck by something. To lower (something) into water; to thrust or plunge under liquid and suddenly withdraw. To go under the surface of water and immediately reappear; to plunge one's head into water or other liquid. To bow.

distort.desc: To bring something out of shape, to misshape. To become misshapen. To give a false or misleading account of; pervert. Distorted; misshapen.

dashboard.desc: An upturned screen of wood or leather placed on the front of a horse-drawn carriage, sleigh or other vehicle that protected the driver from mud, debris, water and snow thrown up by the horse's hooves. A panel beneath the windshield of a vehicle or aircraft containing indicator gauges, compartments, and sometimes controls and indicator lights. The float of a paddle wheel. A graphical user interface for changing settings.

dusty.desc: Covered with dust. Powdery and resembling dust. Grey or greyish. Old; outdated; stuffily traditional.

amazed.desc: Astonished or confounded with fear, surprise, or wonder; greatly surprised (often with ensuing adpositions e.g. at, with, or by).

rack.desc: A series of one or more shelves, stacked one above the other. Any of various kinds of frame for holding luggage or other objects on a vehicle or vessel. A device, incorporating a ratchet, used to torture victims by stretching them beyond their natural limits. A piece or frame of wood, having several sheaves, through which the running rigging passes.

relish.desc: A projecting component. In a wooden frame: the projection or shoulder around, or at the side of, a , used to strengthen a mortise-and-tenon joint. To add one or more relishes ''(noun )'' to (a tenon, piece of wood, etc.). A type of ornamentation comprising one or more trills.

fry.desc: To affect or be affected by extreme heat or current. To entertain (a person) greatly; to make to laugh thoroughly. A long, thin fried piece of cut potato. A long, thin fried piece of other foods.

slippery.desc: Of a surface, having low friction, often due to being covered in a non-viscous liquid, and therefore hard to grip, hard to stand on without falling, etc. Evasive; difficult to pin down. Liable to slip; not standing firm. Unstable; changeable; inconstant.

gladly.desc: In a glad manner; happily. Willingly; certainly.

sucker.desc: A person or animal that sucks, especially a breast or udder; especially a suckling animal, young mammal before it is weaned. An undesired stem growing out of the roots or lower trunk of a shrub or tree, especially from the rootstock of a grafted plant or tree. A parasite; a sponger. An organ or body part that does the sucking; especially a round structure on the bodies of some insects, frogs, and octopuses that allows them to stick to surfaces.

superstitious.desc: Susceptible to superstitions. Arising from or having the character of superstitions. Overexact; unnecessarily scrupulous.

applaud.desc: Applause; applauding. Plaudit. To express approval (of something) by clapping the hands. To praise, or express approval for something or someone.

pamphlet.desc: A small, brief printed work, consisting either of a folded sheet of paper, or several sheets bound together into a booklet with only a paper cover, formerly containing literary compositions, newsletters, and newspapers, but now chiefly informational matter. Such a work containing political material or discussing matters of controversy. A brief handwritten work.

cleanse.desc: To free from dirt; to clean, to purify. To spiritually purify; to free from guilt or sin; to purge. To remove (something seen as unpleasant) from a person, place, or thing. An act of cleansing; a purification.

unbelievably.desc: In a manner that one does not or cannot believe. To an extent not to be believed. Contrary to expectations, amazingly.

apologize.desc: To make an apology or excuse; to acknowledge some fault or offense, with expression of regret for it, by way of amends To express regret that a certain event has occurred. To make an apologia or defense; to act as apologist.

resentful.desc: Inclined to resent, who tends to harbor resentment, when wronged. Harboring resentment, full of resentment, at a given moment.

cave.desc: A large, naturally-occurring cavity formed underground or in the face of a cliff or a hillside. A hole, depression, or gap in earth or rock, whether natural or man-made. A storage cellar, especially for wine or cheese. A place of retreat, such as a man cave.

miserable.desc: In a state of misery: very sad, ill, or poor. Very bad (''at'' something); unskilled, incompetent; hopeless. Of the weather, extremely unpleasant due to being cold, wet, overcast, etc. Wretched; worthless; mean; contemptible.

handbag.desc: A small bag carried in the hand, used either when travelling or to carry tools for a specific job. A small bag used chiefly by women for carrying various small personal items, sometimes considered as a fashion accessory. . To attack verbally or subject to criticism .

symptom.desc: A perceived change in some function, sensation or appearance of a person that indicates a disease or disorder, such as fever, headache or rash; strictly, a symptom is felt or experienced by the patient, while a sign can be detected by an observer. A signal; anything that indicates, or is characteristic of, the presence of something else, especially of something undesirable.

loneliness.desc: A feeling of depression resulting from being alone or from having no companions. The condition or state of being alone or having no companions. The state of being unfrequented or devoid of human activity (''of a place or time''). A desire to be alone; disposition to solitude.

cake.desc: A rich, sweet dessert food, typically made of flour, sugar and eggs and baked in an oven, and often covered in icing. A small mass of baked dough, especially a thin loaf from unleavened dough. A thin wafer-shaped mass of fried batter; a griddlecake or pancake. A block of any various dense materials.

mouth.desc: The front opening of a creature through which food is ingested. The end of a river out of which water flows into a sea or other large body of water; or the end of a tributary out of which water flows into a larger river. An outlet, aperture or orifice. A loud or overly talkative person.

dissolve.desc: To terminate a union of multiple members actively, as by disbanding. To destroy, make disappear. To liquify, melt into a fluid. To be melted, changed into a fluid.

whiz.desc: To make a whirring or hissing sound, similar to that of an object speeding through the air. To rush or move swiftly with such a sound. To throw or spin rapidly. To urinate.

grudgingly.desc: In a manner expressing resentment or lack of desire.

somehow.desc: In one way or another; in a way not yet known or explained; by some means

sleep.desc: To rest in a state of reduced consciousness. To have sexual intercourse (see sleep with). To accommodate in beds. To be careless, inattentive, or unconcerned; not to be vigilant; to live thoughtlessly.

frosty.desc: Cold, chilly; icy. Having frost on it or in it. Having an aloof or inhospitable manner.

dizzying.desc: Tending to make one (actually or metaphorically) dizzy or confused, as of great speed or height.

spade.desc: A garden tool with a handle and a flat blade for digging. Not to be confused with a shovel which is used for moving earth or other materials. A cutting instrument used in flensing a whale. A device for terminating an electrical conductor resembling a small spade. To turn over soil with a spade to loosen the ground for planting.

cellar.desc: An enclosed underground space, often under a building, used for storage or shelter. A wine collection, especially when stored in a cellar. Last place in a league or competition; some rank near last place. A basement.

follower.desc: One who follows, comes after another. Something that comes after another thing. One who is a part of master's physical group, such as a servant or retainer. One who follows mentally, adherer to the opinions, ideas or teachings of another, a movement etc.

bored.desc: Suffering from boredom; mildly annoyed and restless through having nothing to do. Perforated by a hole or holes.

hate.desc: An object of hatred. Hatred. To dislike intensely or greatly. To experience a feeling of hatred.

silverware.desc: Anything manufactured from silver. Anything with a silvery colour. Knives, forks and spoons (whether made from silver or not). Trophies, success in a competition.

fumble.desc: To handle nervously or awkwardly. To grope awkwardly in trying to find something To blunder uncertainly. To grope about in perplexity; to seek awkwardly.

poisonous.desc: Containing sufficient poison to be dangerous to touch or ingest. Of an animal such as a snake or spider, or parts of its body: producing a toxin intended for defensive or offensive use which is usually injected into an enemy or prey by biting or stinging; hence, of a bite or sting: injecting poison. Negative, harmful.

grainy.desc: Resembling grains; granular. ground or gritty.

herd.desc: A number of domestic animals assembled together under the watch or ownership of a keeper. Any collection of animals gathered or travelling in a company. A crowd, a mass of people or things; a rabble. A collection of things, especially vehicles.

postcard.desc: A rectangular piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically used for sending messages by mail without the need for an envelope. To send a postcard to someone. To send by means of a postcard.

abyss.desc: Hell; the bottomless pit; primeval chaos; a confined subterranean ocean. A bottomless or unfathomed depth, gulf, or chasm; hence, any deep, immeasurable; any void space. Anything infinite, immeasurable, or profound. Moral depravity; vast intellectual or moral depth.

motel.desc: A type of hotel or lodging establishment, often located near a major highway, which typically features a series of rooms whose entrances are immediately adjacent to a parking lot to facilitate convenient access to parked automobiles. A low-cost short-stay hotel, often with hourly rates rather than daily rates, and notorious for permitting illicit sexual activities; love hotel. To stay in a motel or motels.

prey.desc: That which is or may be seized by animals to be devoured. A person or thing given up as a victim. A living thing, usually an animal, that is eaten by another living thing. Anything, such as goods, etc., taken or got by violence; something taken by force from an enemy in war.

nut.desc: Any of various hard-shelled seeds or hard, dry fruits from various families of plants. A piece of hardware, typically metal and typically hexagonal or square in shape, with a hole through it having internal screw threads, intended to be screwed onto a threaded bolt or other threaded shaft. The head. A crazy person.

awkward.desc: Lacking dexterity in the use of the hands, or of instruments. Not easily managed or effected; embarrassing. Lacking social skills, or uncomfortable with social interaction. Perverse; adverse; difficult to handle.

marvelous.desc: Exciting wonder or surprise; astonishing; wonderful.

pastel.desc: Any of several subdued tints of colors, usually associated with pink, peach, yellow, green, blue, and lavender. A drawing made with any of those colors. A type of dried paste used to make crayons. A crayon made from such a paste.

comprehend.desc: To understand or grasp fully and thoroughly; to . To include, comprise; to contain.

screw.desc: A device that has a helical function. The motion of screwing something; a turn or twist to one side. A prison guard. An extortioner; a sharp bargainer; a skinflint.

bowel.desc: A part or division of the intestines, usually the large intestine. The entrails or intestines; the internal organs of the stomach. The (deep) interior  something. The seat of pity or the gentler emotions; pity or mercy.

bedroom.desc: A room in a house, apartment, hotel or other dwelling where a bed is kept for sleeping. The location of sexual activity.

activate.desc: To encourage development or induce increased activity; to stimulate. To put a device, mechanism (alarm etc.) or system into action or motion; to trigger, to actuate, to set off, to enable. To render more reactive; excite. To render a molecule reactive, active, or effective in performing its function.

somewhere.desc: In an uncertain or unspecified location. To an uncertain or unspecified location. At some unspecified point. Unspecified or unknown (unlocated) place or location.

scrutinize.desc: To examine something with great care or detail, as to look for hidden or obscure flaws. To audit accounts etc in order to verify them.

frantic.desc: Insane, mentally unstable. In a state of panic, worry, frenzy, or rush. Extremely energetic. A person who is insane or mentally unstable, madman.

uninterested.desc: Not interested; indifferent, not concerned. Unmotivated by personal interest; unbiased, disinterested.

flyer.desc: That which flies, as a bird or insect. A machine that flies. An airplane pilot. A person who travels by airplane.

slide.desc: To (cause to) move in continuous contact with a surface. To move on a low-friction surface. To drop down and skid into a base. To lose one’s balance on a slippery surface.

waiter.desc: A male or female attendant who serves customers at their tables in a restaurant, café or similar. Someone who waits for somebody or something; a person who is waiting. A person working as an attendant at the . A vessel or tray on which something is carried, as dishes, etc.; a salver. (See etymology of .)

lipstick.desc: Makeup for the lips. A stick of this makeup. A dog's penis. .

clever.desc: Nimble with hands or body; dexterous; skillful; adept. Quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent. Mentally quick and resourceful; skilled at achieving what one wants in a mentally agile and inventive way. Smart, intelligent, or witty; mentally quick or sharp.

veil.desc: Something hung up or spread out to hide or protect the face, or hide an object from view; usually of gauze, crepe, or similar diaphanous material. Anything that partially obscures a clear view. A cover; disguise; a mask; a pretense. A covering for a person or thing; as, a caul (especially over the head)

scented.desc: Having a pleasant aroma. Having a smell of any kind. Having perfume added.

momentary.desc: Lasting for only a moment. Happening at every moment; perpetual. Ephemeral or relatively short-lived.

patch.desc: A piece of cloth, or other suitable material, sewed or otherwise fixed upon a garment to repair or strengthen it, especially upon an old garment to cover a hole. A small piece of anything used to repair damage or a breach; as, a patch on a kettle, a roof, etc. A piece of any size, used to repair something for a temporary period only, or that it is temporary because it is not meant to last long or will be removed as soon as a proper repair can be made, which will happen in the near future. A small, usually contrasting but always somehow different or distinct, part of something else (location, time, size)

conditioner.desc: Anything that improves the condition of something. . ; fabric softener. Someone who trains athletes or racehorses.
