indulge.desc: To satisfy the wishes or whims of. To give way to (a habit or temptation); to not oppose or restrain. To grant an extension to the deadline of a payment. To grant as by favour; to bestow in concession, or in compliance with a wish or request.

snub.desc: Conspicuously short. Flat and broad, with the end slightly turned up. Derived from a simpler polyhedron by the addition of extra triangular faces. A deliberate affront or slight.

anticipate.desc: To act before (someone), especially to prevent an action. To take up or introduce (something) prematurely. To know of (something) before it happens; to expect. To eagerly wait for (something)

horror.desc: An intense distressing emotion of fear or repugnance. Something horrible; that which excites horror. Intense dislike or aversion; an abhorrence. A genre of fiction designed to evoke a feeling of fear and suspense.

shallow.desc: Having little depth; significantly less deep than wide. Extending not far downward. Concerned mainly with superficial matters. Lacking interest or substance; flat; one-dimensional.

perverse.desc: Turned aside while against something, splitting off from a thing. Morally wrong or evil; wicked; perverted. Obstinately in the wrong; stubborn; intractable. Wayward; vexing; contrary.

cop.desc: To capture or arrest someone. To obtain, to purchase (items including but not limited to drugs), to get hold of, to take. To (be forced to) take; to receive; to shoulder; to bear, especially blame or punishment for a particular instance of wrongdoing. To see and record a railway locomotive for the first time.

vigil.desc: An instance of keeping awake during normal sleeping hours, especially to keep watch or pray. A period of observation or surveillance at any hour. The eve of a religious festival in which staying awake is part of the ritual devotions. A quiet demonstration in support of a cause.

monologue.desc: A long speech by one person in a play; sometimes a soliloquy; other times spoken to other characters. A long series of comic stories and jokes as an entertainment. A long, uninterrupted utterance that monopolizes a conversation. To speak in or deliver a monologue.

devoid.desc: Completely without; having none of To empty out; to remove.

dormitory.desc: A room containing a number of beds (and often some other furniture and/or utilities) for sleeping, often applied to student and backpacker accommodation of this kind. A building or part of a building which houses students, soldiers, monks etc. who sleep there and use communal further facilities. A dormitory town.

rupture.desc: A burst, split, or break. A social breach or break, between individuals or groups. A break or tear in soft tissue, such as a muscle. A failure mode in which a tough ductile material pulls apart rather than cracking.

hardly.desc: Barely, only just, almost not. Certainly not; not at all. . , severely; in a hard manner.

hulk.desc: A large structure with a dominating presence. A big (and possibly clumsy) person. To move (a large, hulking body). To be a hulk, that is, a large, hulking, and often imposing presence.

dignified.desc: Having an attitude or bearing that connotes respectability and poise.

massage.desc: The action of rubbing, kneading or hitting someone's body, to help the person relax, prepare for muscular action (as in contact sports) or to relieve aches. The action of rubbing or kneading anything. To rub and knead (someone's body or body part), to perform a massage on (somebody). To rub or knead anything.

eagle.desc: Any of several large carnivorous and carrion-eating birds in the family , having a powerful hooked bill and keen vision. A gold coin with a face value of ten dollars, formerly used in the United States. A 13th-century coin minted in Europe and circulated in England as a debased sterling silver penny, outlawed under . A score of two under par for a hole.

multitude.desc: A great amount or number, often of people; abundance, myriad, profusion. The mass of ordinary people; the masses, the populace.

advise.desc: To give advice to; to offer an opinion to, as worthy or expedient to be followed. To recommend; to offer as advice. To formally give information or notice to; to inform or counsel. To consider, to deliberate.

calculate.desc: To determine the value of something or the solution to something by a mathematical process. To determine values or solutions by a mathematical process; reckon. To plan; to expect; to think. To ascertain or predict by mathematical or astrological computations the time, circumstances, or other conditions of; to forecast or compute the character or consequences of.

rainbow.desc: A multicoloured arch in the sky, produced by prismatic refraction of light within droplets of rain in the air. Any prismatic refraction of light showing a spectrum of colours. A wide assortment; a varied multitude. An illusion; a mirage.

uncle.desc: The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent. The male cousin of one’s parent. A source of advice, encouragement, or help. A pawnbroker.

defy.desc: To challenge (someone) or brave (a hazard or opposition). To refuse to obey. To not conform to or follow a pattern, set of rules or expectations. To renounce or dissolve all bonds of affiance, faith, or obligation with; to reject, refuse, or renounce.

incredibly.desc: In an incredible manner; not to be believed. To a great extent; extremely. .

amusement.desc: Entertainment. An activity that is entertaining or amusing, such as dancing, gunning, or fishing.

loose.desc: To let loose, to free from restraints. To unfasten, to loosen. To make less tight, to loosen. Of a grip or hold, to let go.

treacherous.desc: Exhibiting treachery. ; inclined to betray. ; dangerous.

weigh.desc: To determine the weight of an object. Often with "out", to measure a certain amount of something by its weight, e.g. for sale. To determine the intrinsic value or merit of an object, to evaluate. To judge; to estimate.

predictably.desc: In a manner that can be expected or anticipated.

camel.desc: A mammalian beast of burden, much used in desert areas, of the genus . A light brownish color, like that of a camel (also called camel brown). A vessel or tank, typically paired, used to make an object more buoyant. A person of Middle Eastern origin.

sick.desc: In poor health; ill. Having an urge to vomit. Mentally unstable, disturbed. In bad taste.

moss.desc: Any of various small, green, seedless plants growing on the ground or on the surfaces of trees, stones, etc.; now specifically, a plant of the phylum Bryophyta (formerly division ). A kind or species of such plants. Any alga, lichen, bryophyte, or other plant of seemingly simple structure. A bog; a fen.

predator.desc: Any animal or other organism that hunts and kills other nonplant organisms (their prey), primarily for food. Someone who attacks and plunders for gain. A sexual predator.

burner.desc: Someone or something that physically burns or causes something else to burn. A device that records data or music to an optical disc, such as a CD-R or DVD-RW. . An app that creates temporary phone numbers for a user.

lately.desc: Recently; not long ago; of late; not long since. In a late manner; after-the-fact. (''of a peer'') Formerly.

hostess.desc: A female host. A female innkeeper. Stewardess: a woman steward on an airplane. A bar hostess or bargirl; a paid female companion offering conversation and in some cases sex.

exquisite.desc: Especially or extraordinarily fine or pleasing; exceptional. Carefully adjusted; precise; accurate; exact. Recherché; far-fetched; abstruse. Of special beauty or rare excellence.

mock.desc: An imitation, usually of lesser quality. ; the act of mocking. . A mockup or prototype; ''particularly'', , as used in unit testing.

distracted.desc: having one's attention diverted; preoccupied; distrait (literary) distraught

rendezvous.desc: A meeting or date. An agreement to meet at a certain place and time. A place appointed for a meeting, or at which persons customarily meet. The appointed place for troops, or for the ships of a fleet, to assemble; also, a place for enlistment.

stretcher.desc: Someone or something that stretches. A simple litter designed to carry a sick, injured, or dead person. A frame on which a canvas is stretched for painting. A device to stretch shoes or gloves.

cream.desc: The butterfat or milkfat part of milk which rises to the top; this part when separated from the remainder. A yellowish white color; the color of cream. Frosting, custard, creamer or another substance similar to the oily part of milk or to whipped cream. A dish prepared through creaming, particularly ''cream of''

cabin.desc: A small dwelling characteristic of the frontier, especially when built from logs with simple tools and not constructed by professional builders, but by those who meant to live in it. A chalet or lodge, especially one that can hold large groups of people. A private room on a ship. The interior of a boat, enclosed to create a small room, particularly for sleeping.

blind.desc: Unable to see, or only partially able to see. Failing to recognize, acknowledge or perceive. Having little or no visibility. Closed at one end; having a dead end; exitless.

scrap.desc: A (small) piece; a fragment; a detached, incomplete portion. Leftover food. The crisp substance that remains after drying out animal fat. Discarded objects (especially metal) that may be dismantled to recover their constituent materials, junk.

delicate.desc: Easily damaged or requiring careful handling. Characterized by a fine structure or thin lines. Intended for use with fragile items. Refined; gentle; scrupulous not to trespass or offend; considerate; said of manners, conduct, or feelings.

plague.desc: The bubonic plague, the pestilent disease caused by the virulent bacterium . An epidemic or pandemic caused by any pestilence, but especially that caused by the above disease. A widespread affliction, calamity, or destructive influx, especially when seen as divine retribution. A grave nuisance, whatever greatly irritates.

disgrace.desc: The condition of being out of favor; loss of favor, regard, or respect. The state of being dishonored, or covered with shame. Someone or something which brings dishonor; the cause of reproach or shame; great discredit. An act of unkindness; a disfavor.

hangover.desc: Negative effects, such as headache or nausea, caused by previous drunkenness due to (excessive) consumption of alcohol. Similar negative effects caused by previous excessive consumption of another substance, such as a drug, coffee, sugar, etc. An unpleasant relic left from prior events. A sleeping arrangement, usually in homeless shelters, over a rope.

bathing.desc: The act of taking a bath. The act of swimming.

unimaginable.desc: to be imagined; inconceivable or mind-boggling; beyond belief.

accidentally.desc: In an accidental manner; by chance, unexpectedly. Unintentionally.

sand.desc: Rock that is ground more finely than gravel, but is not as fine as silt (more formally, see grain sizes chart), forming beaches and deserts and also used in construction. Personal courage. A particle from 62.5 microns to 2 mm in diameter, following the Wentworth scale. A light beige colour, like that of typical sand.

momentous.desc: Outstanding in importance, of great consequence.

bath.desc: A tub or pool which is used for bathing: bathtub. A building or area where bathing occurs. . The act of bathing; an instance of this; the taking of a bath.

lunch.desc: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day. A break in play between the first and second sessions. Any small meal, especially one eaten at a social gathering. A thin piece or hunk

taste.desc: One of the sensations produced by the tongue in response to certain chemicals; the quality of giving this sensation. The sense that consists in the perception and interpretation of this sensation. A small sample of food, drink, or recreational drugs. A person's implicit set of preferences, especially esthetic, though also culinary, sartorial, etc.

disable.desc: To render unable; to take away an ability of, as by crippling. To impair the physical or mental abilities of; to cause a serious, permanent injury. To deactivate, to make inoperational (especially of a function of an electronic or mechanical device). Lacking ability; unable.

supernatural.desc: Above nature; beyond or added to nature, often so considered because it is given by a deity or some force beyond that with which humans are born. Not of the usual; not natural; altered by forces that are not understood fully, if at all. A supernatural being Supernatural beings and events collectively

token.desc: Something serving as an expression of something else. A keepsake. A piece of stamped metal or plastic, etc., used as a form of currency; a voucher that can be exchanged for goods or services. A small physical object, often designed to give the appearance of a common thing, used to represent a person or character in a board game or other situation.

spike.desc: A sort of very large nail. A piece of pointed metal etc. set with points upward or outward. Anything resembling such a nail in shape. An ear of corn or grain.

hearted.desc: Having a specified kind or number of heart. Seated or fixed in the heart.

unwelcome.desc: Not welcome. To treat as unwelcome.

gel.desc: A semi-solid to almost solid colloid of a solid and a liquid, such as jelly, cheese or opal. Any gel intended for a particular cosmetic use, such as for styling the hair. A film of flexible transparent plastic (such as acetate, celluloid, or cellophane) suitable for making superimpositions or diapositives (image to overlay on other images, especially for overhead projectors); a digital virtual equivalent of this. To apply (cosmetic) gel to (the hair, etc).

wonderful.desc: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary. Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive. Exceedingly, to a great extent.

bureaucrat.desc: An official who is part of a bureaucracy. A user on a wiki with the right to change user access levels.

backwards.desc: ''; see usage notes there.'' ''; see usage notes there.''

bust.desc: To break. To arrest (someone or a group of people) for a crime. To catch (someone) in the act of doing something wrong, socially and morally inappropriate, or illegal, especially when being done in a sneaky or secretive state. To debunk, dispel (a belief).

tame.desc: Under human control. Docile or tranquil towards humans. Of a person, well-behaved; not radical or extreme. Of a non-Westernised person, accustomed to European society.

dangerously.desc: In a dangerous manner; so as to cause danger.

jittery.desc: nervy, jumpy, on edge Having jitter, or unwanted signal characteristics.

survive.desc: Of a person, to continue to live; to remain alive. Of an object or concept, to continue to exist. To live past (a life-threatening event) To live longer than (someone); to outlive (someone or something); to outlast (something).

horse.desc: A hoofed mammal, , often used throughout history for riding and draft work. A mass of earthy matter, or rock of the same character as the wall rock, occurring in the course of a vein, as of coal or ore; hence, to ''take horse'' (said of a vein) is to divide into branches for a distance. An informal variant of basketball in which players match shots made by their opponent(s), each miss adding a letter to the word "horse", with 5 misses spelling the whole word and eliminating a player, until only the winner is left. Also HORSE, H-O-R-S-E or H.O.R.S.E. (see ). The flesh of a horse as an item of cuisine.

brake.desc: A device used to slow or stop the motion of a wheel, or of a vehicle, usually by friction (although other resistive forces, such as electromagnetic fields or aerodynamic drag, can also be used); also, the controls or apparatus used to engage such a mechanism such as the pedal in a car. An ancient engine of war analogous to the crossbow and ballista. The handle of a pump. A baker’s kneading trough.

foot.desc: A biological structure found in many animals that is used for locomotion and that is frequently a separate organ at the terminal part of the leg. Specifically, a human foot, which is found below the ankle and is used for standing and walking. Travel by walking. The base or bottom of anything.

impulse.desc: A thrust; a push; a sudden force that impels. A wish or urge, particularly a sudden one prompting action. The integral of force over time. To impel; to incite.

smooth.desc: Having a texture that lacks friction. Not rough. Without difficulty, problems, or unexpected consequences or incidents. ; glib. Flowing or uttered without check, obstruction, or hesitation; not harsh; fluent.

collect.desc: To gather together; amass. To get; particularly, get from someone. To accumulate (a number of similar or related objects), particularly for a hobby or recreation. To pick up or fetch [someone, in a vehicle]

dope.desc: Any viscous liquid or paste, such as a lubricant, used in preparing a surface. An absorbent material used to hold a liquid. Any varnish used to coat a part, such as an airplane wing or a hot-air balloon in order to waterproof, strengthen, etc. Any of various recreational substances:

brass.desc: A metallic alloy of copper and zinc used in many industrial and plumbing applications. A class of wind instruments, usually made of metal (such as brass), that use vibrations of the player's lips to produce sound; a band or the section of an orchestra that features such instruments. Spent cartridge casings (usually made of brass): the part of the cartridge left over after bullets or shells have been fired. The color of brass ''()''.

blow.desc: To produce an air current. To propel by an air current (or, if under water, a water current), usually with the mouth. To be propelled by an air current. To direct or move, usually of a person to a particular location.

wit.desc: Sanity. The senses. Intellectual ability; faculty of thinking, reasoning. The ability to think quickly; mental cleverness, especially under short time constraints.

nurture.desc: The act of nourishing or nursing; tender care That which nourishes; food; diet. The environmental influences that contribute to a person’s development (as opposed to "nature"). The act or process of encouraging the growth or development of something.

mold.desc: A hollow form or matrix for shaping a fluid or plastic substance. A frame or model around or on which something is formed or shaped. Something that is made in or shaped on a mold. The shape or pattern of a mold.

ceramic.desc: Made of material produced by the high-temperature firing of inorganic, nonmetallic rocks and minerals. A hard, brittle, inorganic, nonmetallic material, made by firing a material such as clay at a high temperature. An object made of this material.

urgently.desc: With great haste, with a sense of urgency, because it is very important. Continuously. With insistence.

quaint.desc: Of a person: cunning, crafty. Cleverly made; artfully contrived. Strange or odd; unusual. Overly discriminating or needlessly meticulous; fastidious; prim.

innate.desc: Inborn; existing or having existed since birth. Originating in, or derived from, the constitution of the intellect, as opposed to acquired from experience. Instinctive; coming from instinct. Joined by the base to the very tip of a filament.

womb.desc: In female mammals, the organ in which the young are conceived and grow until birth; the uterus. The abdomen or stomach. The stomach of a person or creature. A place where something is made or formed.

ginger.desc: The pungent aromatic rhizome of a tropical Asian herb, , used as a spice and as a stimulant and acarminative. The plant that produces this rhizome. Other species belonging to the same family, , especially those of the genus A reddish-brown color.

dodge.desc: To avoid (something) by moving suddenly out of the way. To avoid; to sidestep. To elude. To go, or cause to go, hither and thither.

baton.desc: A staff or truncheon, used for various purposes. A ceremonial staff of a field marshal or a similar high-ranking military office. The stick of a conductor in musical performances. An object transferred by runners in a relay race.

contradict.desc: To deny the truth or validity of (a statement or statements). To oppose (a person) by denying the truth or pertinence of a given statement. To be contrary to (something). To say things that conflict with each other.

unto.desc: Up to the time or degree that; until. ; . ; . the last; encompassing even every.

slam.desc: To shut with sudden force so as to produce a shock and noise. To put in or on a particular place with force and loud noise. (Often followed by a preposition such as ''down'', ''against'' or ''into''.) To strike forcefully with some implement. To strike against suddenly and heavily.

downright.desc: A low grade of wool from the lower parts of the sides of a fleece. A vertical line; a perpendicular, a vertical.

hood.desc: A covering for the head, usually attached to a larger garment such as a jacket or cloak. A distinctively colored fold of material, representing a university degree. An enclosure that protects something, especially from above. To cover (something) with a hood.

diagnose.desc: To determine which disease is causing a sick person's signs and symptoms; to find the diagnosis. To determine the cause of a problem.

constraint.desc: Something that constrains; a restriction. An irresistible force or compulsion. The repression of one's feelings. A condition that a solution to an optimization problem must satisfy.

scout.desc: A person sent out to gather and bring back information; especially, one employed in war to gain information about the enemy and ground. An act of scouting or reconnoitering. A member of any number of youth organizations belonging to the international scout movement, such as the Boy Scouts of America or Girl Scouts of the United States. A person who assesses or recruits others; especially, one who identifies promising talent on behalf of a sports team.

senseless.desc: Without feeling or desire to work; deprived of sensation. Lacking meaning or purpose; without common sense. Without a discernible meaning or purpose, especially of a violent or evil act. Without consideration, awareness or sound judgement

attire.desc: One's dress; what one wears; one's clothes. The single horn of a goat, deer or stag. To clothe or adorn.

fanatic.desc: Fanatical. Showing evidence of possession by a god or demon; frenzied, overzealous. A person who is zealously enthusiastic for some cause.

insert.desc: To put in between or into. An image inserted into text. A promotional or instructive leaflet inserted into a magazine, newspaper, tape or disk package, etc. A mechanical component inserted into another.

transform.desc: To change greatly the appearance or form of. To change the nature, condition or function of; to change in nature, disposition, heart, character, etc.; to convert. To subject to a transformation; to change into another form without altering the value. To subject to the action of a transformer.

sparse.desc: Having widely spaced intervals. Not dense; meager; scanty Having few nonzero elements To disperse, to scatter.

queue.desc: A line of people, vehicles or other objects, usually one to be dealt with in sequence (i.e., the one at the front end is dealt with first, the one behind is dealt with next, and so on), and which newcomers join at the opposite end (the back). A waiting list or other means of organizing people or objects into a first-come-first-served order. A data structure in which objects are added to one end, called the tail, and removed from the other, called the head (in the case of a FIFO queue). The term can also refer to a LIFO ''queue'' or stack where these ends coincide. An animal's tail.

angular.desc: Relating or pertaining to an angle, or angles. Having an angle or angles; forming an angle or corner. Sharp-cornered; pointed. Measured by an angle.

absorb.desc: To include so that it no longer has separate existence; to overwhelm; to cause to disappear as if by swallowing up; to incorporate; to assimilate; to take in and use up. To engulf, as in water; to swallow up. To suck up; to drink in; to imbibe, like a sponge or as the lacteals of the body; to chemically take in. To be absorbed, or sucked in; to sink in.

prisoner.desc: A person incarcerated in a prison, while on trial or serving a sentence. Any person held against their will. A person who is or feels confined or trapped by a situation or a set of circumstances.

delete.desc: To remove, get rid of or erase, especially written or printed material, or data on a computer or other device. To defeat or dominate. To kill or murder. A deletion.

mighty.desc: A warrior of great strength and courage. Very strong; possessing might. Very heavy and powerful. Very large; hefty.

crane.desc: Any bird of the family , large birds with long legs and a long neck which is extended during flight. , the great blue heron. A mechanical lifting machine or device, often used for lifting heavy loads for industrial or construction purposes. An iron arm with horizontal motion, attached to the side or back of a fireplace for supporting kettles etc. over the fire.

firsthand.desc: , without intermediate stages. Not previously owned or used; contrasted with . or from personal experience.

roof.desc: The external covering at the top of a building. The top external level of a building. The upper part of a cavity. The surface or bed of rock immediately overlying a bed of coal or a flat vein.

safely.desc: In a safe manner; without risk; using caution above all else. In a secure manner; without the possibility of injury or harm resulting.

resemble.desc: To be like or similar to (something); to represent as similar. To compare; to regard as similar, to liken. To counterfeit; to imitate. To cause to imitate or be like; to make similar.

refine.desc: To purify; reduce to a fine, unmixed, or pure state; to free from impurities. To become pure; to be cleared of impure matter. To purify of coarseness, vulgarity, inelegance, etc.; to polish. To improve in accuracy, delicacy, or excellence.

habit.desc: An action performed on a regular basis. An action performed repeatedly and automatically, usually without awareness. An addiction. To clothe.

rowdy.desc: Loud and disorderly; riotous; boisterous. A boisterous person; a brawler. money; ready money.

lift.desc: To raise or rise. To steal. To source directly without acknowledgement; to plagiarise. To arrest (a person).

shoreline.desc: The divide between land and a body of water. The line on a map that illustrates this.

sunset.desc: The moment each evening when the sun disappears below the western horizon. The changes in color of the sky before and after sunset. The final period of the life of a person or thing. A set termination date.

hesitant.desc: Tending to hesitate, wait, or proceed with caution or reservation.

disdain.desc: A feeling of contempt or scorn. That which is worthy to be disdained or regarded with contempt and aversion. The state of being despised; shame. To regard (someone or something) with strong contempt.

timer.desc: One who has done something a certain number of times. One characterized by a certain time or time frame, such as their work hours.

elevate.desc: To raise (something) to a higher position. To promote (someone) to a higher rank. To confer honor or nobility on (someone). To make (something or someone) more worthy or of greater value.

genuinely.desc: In a genuine manner; truthfully, truly.

knee.desc: In humans, the joint or the region of the joint in the middle part of the leg between the thigh and the shank. In the horse and allied animals, the carpal joint, corresponding to the wrist in humans. In birds: The part of a garment that covers the knee.

grocery.desc: Retail foodstuffs and other household supplies. A shop or store that sells groceries; a grocery store. To go grocery shopping. To furnish with groceries.

charming.desc: Pleasant, charismatic. Delightful in a playful way which avoids responsibility or seriousness, as if attracting through a magical charm. The casting of a magical charm. Used in response to behaviour or language considered offensive or uncouth.

narrow.desc: Having a small width; not wide; having opposite edges or sides that are close, especially by comparison to length or depth. Of little extent; very limited; circumscribed. ; without flexibility or latitude. Contracted; of limited scope; bigoted

fashioned.desc: Having a specified fashion or style In style; fashionable. Well designed or put together.

shorthand.desc: A rough and rapid method of writing by substituting symbols for letters, words, etc. Any brief or shortened way of saying or doing something. To render (spoken or written words) into shorthand. To use a brief or shortened way of saying or doing something.

junk.desc: Miscellaneous items of little value, especially discarded or unwanted items. Material or resources of poor quality or low value, especially resources that lack commercial value. ; gibberish. Any narcotic drug, especially heroin.

etiquette.desc: The manners or decent behaviour to be observed in social or professional life; conventional decorum; the ceremonial code of polite society. The customary behavior of members of a profession, business, law, or sports team towards each other. A label used to indicate that a letter is to be sent by airmail.

racket.desc: An implement with a handle connected to a round frame strung with wire, sinew, or plastic cords, and used to hit a ball, such as in tennis or a shuttlecock in badminton. A snowshoe formed of cords stretched across a long and narrow frame of light wood. A broad wooden shoe or patten for a man or horse, to allow walking on marshy or soft ground. To strike with, or as if with, a racket.

instruction.desc: The act of instructing, teaching, or providing with information or knowledge. An instance of the information or knowledge so furnished. An order or command. A set of directions provided by a manufacturer for the users of a product or service.

shaky.desc: Shaking or trembling. Nervous, anxious. Full of shakes or cracks; cracked. Easily shaken; tottering; unsound.

boast.desc: A brag; ostentatious positive appraisal of oneself. Something that one brags about. A shot where the ball is driven off a side wall and then strikes the front wall. To brag; to talk loudly in praise of oneself.

bounty.desc: Generosity; also  an act of generosity. Something given liberally; a gift. A reward for some specific act, especially one given by an authority or a government. An abundance or wealth.

fortress.desc: A fortified place; a large and permanent fortification, sometimes including a town; for example a fort, a castle; a stronghold; a place of defense or security. A position that, if obtained by the weaker side, will prevent penetration by the opposing side, generally achieving a draw. To furnish with a fortress or with fortresses; to guard, to fortify.

elegant.desc: Characterised by or exhibiting elegance; having grace, refinement, or tasteful simplicity. Characterised by minimalism and intuitiveness while preserving exactness and precision. Fine; doing well. An elegant parrot.

heavenly.desc: Of or pertaining to Heaven, the eternal celestial abode of God or the gods. Strongly or sublimely good, beautiful, or pleasurable. In a manner like that of heaven; by the influence or agency of heaven; divinely, miraculously. To a degree such as to elicit great pleasure.

unnecessarily.desc: In an unnecessary way; not by necessity. To an extent beyond what is needed.

lumber.desc: Wood sawn into planks or otherwise prepared for sale or use, especially as a building material. Old furniture or other items that take up room, or are stored away. Useless or cumbrous material. A pawnbroker's shop, or room for storing articles put in pawn; hence, a pledge, or pawn.

beautiful.desc: Possessing beauty, impressing the eye; attractive. That one likes very much. Affording pleasure to any of the senses, especially that of hearing; delightful. Impressing with charm in an intellectual or moral way, through inherent suitability or elegance.

shark.desc: Any predatory fish of the superorder , with a cartilaginous skeleton and 5 to 7 gill slits on each side of its head. of this animal, consumed as food. Any fish of the class , especially an extinct shark-like holocephalian. A freshwater fish that resembles a true shark () in appearance or movement; a freshwater shark.

busy.desc: Crowded with business or activities; having a great deal going on. with or preoccupied by an activity or person. Having much work to do; having much to get done. Having a lot going on; complicated or intricate.

inform.desc: To instruct, train (usually in matters of knowledge). To communicate knowledge to. To impart information or knowledge. To act as an informer; denounce.

assorted.desc: Composed of a number of different kinds or types; mixed; miscellaneous.

excellent.desc: Having excelled, having surpassed. Of higher or the highest quality; splendid. Exceptionally good of its kind. Superior in kind or degree, irrespective of moral quality.

prematurely.desc: In a premature manner; too soon or too early.

anchor.desc: A tool used to moor a vessel to the bottom of a sea or river to resist movement. An iron device so shaped as to grip the bottom and hold a vessel at her berth by the chain or rope attached. The combined anchoring gear (anchor, rode, bill/peak and fittings such as bitts, cat, and windlass.) Representation of the nautical tool, used as a heraldic charge.

candid.desc: Impartial and free from prejudice. Straightforward, open and sincere, whether people find either refreshing or distasteful. Unposed or rehearsed. Bright; white.

feminine.desc: Of or pertaining to the female gender. Of or pertaining to the female sex; biologically female, not male. Belonging to females; typically used by females. Having the qualities stereotypically associated with women: nurturing, not aggressive, sensual; womanly.

queen.desc: The wife, consort, or widow of a king. A female monarch. A woman whose pre-eminence, power, or forcefulness is comparable to that of a queen. Something regarded as the greatest of its kind or as having pre-eminence or power comparable to that of a queen over a given area.

extract.desc: Something that is extracted or drawn out. A portion of a book, document, recording etc. incorporated distinctly in another work (for written or spoken words, synoymous to a citation; a quotation). A decoction, solution, or infusion made by drawing out from any substance that which gives it its essential and characteristic virtue Any substance extracted is such a way, and characteristic of that from which it is obtained

blessing.desc: Some kind of divine or supernatural aid, or reward. A pronouncement invoking divine aid. Good fortune. A modern pagan ceremony.

honesty.desc: The act, quality, or condition of being honest. Honor; decency, propriety. Chastity. Any of various crucifers in the genus , several of which are grown as ornamentals, particularly  ().

gravity.desc: The word 'gravity' and its common associations.

paternal.desc: Of or pertaining to one's father, his genes, his relatives, or his side of a family. A person related through the father, or his side of the family; a paternal relative.

retribution.desc: Punishment inflicted in the spirit of moral outrage or personal vengeance.

subtle.desc: People or things that are subtle ''(adjective sense)'' as a class. To make (something) . To burn (someone or something) to ash.

violin.desc: A small unfretted stringed instrument with four strings tuned (lowest to highest) G-D-A-E, usually held against the chin and played with a bow. Any instrument of the , always inclusive of violins, violas and cellos, and sometimes further including the double bass. A violinist in an orchestra or group. To play on, or as if on, a violin.

cook.desc: A person who prepares food. The head cook of a manor house. The degree or quality of cookedness of food. The member of a hot-rivetting team who heats the rivets in a brazier, see rivet.

unfortunate.desc: Not favored by fortune. or accompanied by or resulting in misfortune. Regrettable or unsuitable. An unlucky person; one who has fallen into bad circumstances.

guide.desc: Someone who guides, especially someone hired to show people around a place or an institution and offer information and explanation, or to lead them through dangerous terrain. A document or book that offers information or instruction; guidebook. A sign that guides people; guidepost. Any marking or object that catches the eye to provide quick reference.

ambush.desc: The act of concealing oneself and lying in wait to attack or kill by surprise. An attack launched from a concealed position. The concealed position or state from which a surprise attack is launched. The troops posted in a concealed place, for attacking by surprise; those who lie in wait.

unreasonable.desc: Without the ability to reason; unreasoning. Not reasonable; going beyond what could be expected or asked for.

experiment.desc: A test under controlled conditions made to either demonstrate a known truth, examine the validity of a hypothesis, or determine the efficacy or likelihood of something previously untried. Experience, practical familiarity with something. To conduct an experiment. To experience; to feel; to perceive; to detect.

craft.desc: Strength; power; might; force . Intellectual power; skill; art. A work or product of art . A device, a means; a magical device, spell or enchantment .

convenient.desc: Serving to reduce a difficulty, or accessible with minimum difficulty; expedient. Suspicious due to suiting someone's purposes very well. Fit; suitable; appropriate.

boutique.desc: A small shop, especially one that sells fashionable clothes, jewelry and the like. A small shop located within a larger one. A film production company making only a few movies per year. Any company that has an exclusively smaller client base generally in a niche market or specializing in bespoke or custom-made products or services.

identical.desc: Bearing full likeness by having precisely the same set of characteristics; indistinguishable. Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; numerically identical. Of twins, sharing the same genetic code. Exactly equivalent.

diamond.desc: A glimmering glass-like mineral that is an allotrope of carbon in which each atom is surrounded by four others in the form of a tetrahedron. A gemstone made from this mineral. A diamond ring. A very pale blue color.

literally.desc: In a literal manner; exactly as stated, word for word. just, merely.

motion.desc: A change whereby something goes from one place to another; a state of progression from one place to another; a change of position with respect to time. A parliamentary action to propose something.  A similar procedure in any official or business meeting. An entertainment or show, especially a puppet show. from κίνησις (kinesis); any change. Traditionally of four types: generation and corruption, alteration, augmentation and diminution, and change of place.

sympathetic.desc: Of, related to, feeling, showing, or characterized by sympathy. Attracting the liking of others. Relating to, producing, or denoting an effect which arises through an affinity, interdependence, or mutual association. Relating to or denoting the part of the autonomic nervous system consisting of nerves arising from ganglia near the middle part of the spinal cord, supplying the internal organs, blood vessels, and glands, and balancing the action of the parasympathetic nerves.

devote.desc: to give one's time, focus one's efforts, commit oneself, etc. entirely for, on, or to a certain matter; to consecrate. to consign over; to doom to execrate; to curse devoted; addicted; devout

nuts.desc: The testicles. An unbeatable hand; the best poker hand available. Insane, mad. Crazy, mad; unusually pleased or, alternatively, angered.

particle.desc: A very small piece of matter, a fragment; especially, the smallest possible part of something. Any of various physical objects making up the constituent parts of an atom; an elementary particle or subatomic particle. A part of speech that has no inherent lexical definition but must be associated with another word to impart meaning, often a grammatical category: for example, the English word ''to'' in a full infinitive phrase (''to eat'') or ''O'' in a vocative phrase (O Canada), or as a discourse marker (''mmm''). A part of speech which cannot be inflected.

airplane.desc: A powered heavier-than-air aircraft with fixed wings: a fixed-wing aircraft with at least one engine or electric motor. Any of various small flyable objects that are notionally comparable to such aircraft but aren't powered. A game to encourage small children to eat, in which the parent or carer pretends that a spoonful of food is an aircraft flying into the child's mouth; the spoonful itself. To fly in an aeroplane.

pose.desc: Common cold, head cold; catarrh. To place in an attitude or fixed position, for the sake of effect. To ask; to set (a test, quiz, riddle, etc.). To constitute (a danger, a threat, a risk, etc.).

notoriously.desc: In a notorious or notable manner; as is commonly known.

havoc.desc: Widespread devastation and destruction. Mayhem. To pillage. To cause havoc.

surpass.desc: To go beyond or exceed (something) in an adjudicative or literal sense.

sure.desc: Physically secure and certain, non-failing, reliable. Certain in one's knowledge or belief. Certain to act or be a specified way. Certain to obtain something.

hire.desc: A person who has been hired, especially in a cohort. The state of being hired, or having a job; employment. Payment for the temporary use of something. Reward.

ethic.desc: Moral, relating to morals. A set of principles of right and wrong behaviour guiding, or representative of, a specific culture, society, group, or individual. The morality of an action.

uproar.desc: , noisy excitement. , confused noise, especially when coming from several sources. A loud protest, controversy, or outrage. To throw into uproar or confusion.

resentment.desc: or displeasure stemming from belief that one or one's group has been wronged or betrayed by others; indignation. The state of holding something in the mind as a subject of contemplation, or of being inclined to reflect upon it; feeling; impression. ; gratitude.

courageous.desc: Of a person, displaying or possessing courage. Of an action, that requires courage.

tissue.desc: Thin, woven, gauzelike fabric. A fine transparent silk material, used for veils, etc.; specifically, cloth interwoven with gold or silver threads, or embossed with figures. A sheet of absorbent paper, especially one that is made to be used as tissue paper, toilet paper or a handkerchief. Absorbent paper as material.

regard.desc: A steady look, a gaze. One's concern for another; esteem; relation, reference. A particular aspect or detail; respect, sense. The worth or estimation in which something or someone is held.

shop.desc: An establishment that sells goods or services to the public; originally only a physical location, but now a virtual establishment as well. A place where things are manufactured or crafted; a workshop. A large garage where vehicle mechanics work. Workplace; office. Used mainly in expressions such as ''shop talk'', ''closed shop'' and ''shop floor''.

forceful.desc: Capable of either physical or coercive force; powerful.

divide.desc: To split or separate (something) into two or more parts. To separate into two or more parts. To share (something) by dividing it. To cause (a group of people) to .

meat.desc: The flesh (muscle tissue) of a killed animal used as food. A food designed to replicate its taste and texture (such as plant-based meat). A type of meat, by anatomic position and provenance. , for animals or humans, especially solid food.

intriguing.desc: Causing a desire to know more; mysterious. Involving oneself in secret plots or schemes. Having clandestine or illicit intercourse. An intrigue.

commonplace.desc: Ordinary; not having any remarkable characteristics. A platitude or cliché. Something that is ordinary; something commonly done or occurring. A memorandum; something to be frequently consulted or referred to.

phrase.desc: A short written or spoken expression. A word or, more commonly, a group of words that functions as a single unit in the syntax of a sentence, always containing an expressed or implied head (the principal word or subgroup, with core importance) and often consisting of a head plus some other elaborating words. A small section of music in a larger piece. A mode or form of speech; diction; expression.

page.desc: One of the many pieces of paper bound together within a book or similar document. One side of a paper leaf in a bound document. A collective memory; noteworthy event; memorable episode. The type set up for printing a page.

pier.desc: A raised platform built from the shore out over water, supported on piles; used to secure, or provide access to shipping; a jetty. A similar structure, especially at a seaside resort, used to provide entertainment. A structure supporting the junction between two spans of a bridge. A rectangular pillar, or similar structure, that supports an arch, wall or roof, or the hinges of a gate.

prove.desc: To demonstrate that something is true or viable; to give proof for; to bear out; to testify. To turn out; to manifest. To turn out to be. To put to the test, to make trial of.

apart.desc: Placed separately (in regard to space or time). Separately, exclusively, not together. In or into two or more parts. To the side; aside.

bra.desc: An item of clothing, usually underwear worn to support the breasts. One of the two vectors in the standard notation for describing quantum states in quantum mechanics, the row vector; the other (column) vector being its complex conjugate, the ket. ; friend, mate

distrust.desc: Lack of trust or confidence. To put no trust in; to have no confidence in.

isolate.desc: To set apart or cut off from others. To place in quarantine or isolation. To separate a substance in pure form from a mixture. To insulate, or make free of external influence.

utmost.desc: ; situated at the most distant limit; farthest, outermost. The most extreme; greatest, ultimate. The greatest possible capability, extent, or quantity; maximum.

notwithstanding.desc: , all the same. ; despite the fact that; even though. , despite. , despite.

coma.desc: A state of unconsciousness from which one may not wake up, usually induced by some form of trauma. A cloud of dust surrounding the nucleus of a comet. A defect characterized by diffuse, pear-shaped images that in an ideal image would appear as points. A tuft or bunch, such as the assemblage of branches forming the head of a tree, a cluster of bracts when empty and terminating the inflorescence of a plant, or a tuft of long hairs on certain seeds.

irrelevant.desc: Not relevant, as: No longer famous or popular; washed up.

affinity.desc: A natural attraction or feeling of kinship to a person or thing. A family relationship through marriage of a relative (e.g. sister-in-law), as opposed to consanguinity (e.g. sister). A kinsman or kinswoman of a such relationship; one who is affinal. The fact of and manner in which something is related to another.

dictate.desc: An order or command. To order, command, control. To speak in order for someone to write down the words. To determine or decisively affect.

height.desc: The distance from the base to the top of something. The distance of something above the ground or some other chosen level. A high point. A quality of vowels, indicating the vertical position of the tongue relative to the roof of the mouth; in practice, the first formant, associated with the height of the tongue.

rocky.desc: Abounding in, or full of, rocks; consisting of rocks. Like a rock; rigid, solid. (Of an animal or plant) Having a habitat around or on rocks. Not easily affected or impressed; stony; hard; obdurate; unfeeling.

fatigue.desc: A weariness caused by exertion; exhaustion. A menial task or tasks, especially in the military. Weakening and eventual failure of material, typically by cracking leading to complete separation, caused by repeated application of mechanical stress to the material. .

carry.desc: To lift (something) and take it to another place; to transport (something) by lifting. To notionally transfer from one place (such as a country, book, or column) to another. To convey by extension or continuance; to extend. To move; to convey using force

disappearance.desc: The action of disappearing or vanishing. Passing out of sight. Leaving secretly of without explanation of existence.

ruler.desc: A (usually rigid), flat, rectangular measuring or drawing device with graduations in units of measurement; a straightedge with markings. A person who rules or governs; someone or something that exercises dominion or controlling power over others. To beat with a ruler (as a traditional school punishment).

fortunate.desc: Auspicious. Happening by good luck or favorable chance. Favored by fortune.

weaken.desc: To make weaker or less strong. To become weaker or less strong.

digest.desc: To distribute or arrange methodically; to work over and classify; to reduce to portions for ready use or application. To separate (the food) in its passage through the alimentary canal into the nutritive and nonnutritive elements; to prepare, by the action of the digestive juices, for conversion into blood; to convert into chyme. To think over and arrange methodically in the mind; to reduce to a plan or method; to receive in the mind and consider carefully; to get an understanding of; to comprehend. To bear comfortably or patiently; to be reconciled to; to brook.

gangster.desc: A member of a criminal or street gang. A member of a professional criminal organization (in organized crime): a racketeer. To act like a gangster; to commit street crime or run a racket. Characteristic of a gangster;  admirable and audacious.

irregular.desc: Nonstandard; not conforming to rules or expectations. Of a surface, rough. Without symmetry, regularity, or uniformity. Of a polygon, not regular; having sides that are not equal or angles that are not equal.

instrument.desc: A device used to produce music. A means or agency for achieving an aspect. A measuring or displaying device. A tool, implement used for manipulation or measurement.

illustrate.desc: To clarify something by giving, or serving as, an example or a comparison. To provide a book or other publication with pictures, diagrams or other explanatory or decorative features. To shed light upon. To give renown or honour to; to make illustrious.

midnight.desc: The middle of the night: the sixth temporal hour, equidistant between sunset and sunrise. Twelve o'clock at night exactly. . Utterly dark or black.

harsh.desc: Unpleasantly rough to the touch or other senses. Severe or cruel. To negatively criticize. To put a damper on (a mood).

talk.desc: To communicate, usually by means of speech. To discuss; to talk about. To speak (a certain language). To confess, especially implicating others.

devout.desc: Devoted to religion or to religious feelings and duties; pious; extremely religious; godly. Expressing devotion or piety. devoted; hearty; sincere; earnest. A devotee.

amend.desc: To make better; improve. To become better. To heal (someone sick); to cure (a disease etc.). To be healed, to be cured, to recover (from an illness).

maple.desc: A small tree, , known as the , field maple, or , which has palmate leaves with five lobes and winged seeds, and is chiefly native to East Asia, Europe, North Africa, and North America. The flavour of maple syrup made from the sap of a maple tree, or an imitation of that flavour. (“the field pea () which has brown, speckled seeds used dry rather than fresh; a seed of this plant”). Of the light-brown colour of the wood of a maple tree ''()''.

contain.desc: To hold inside. To include as a part. To put constraints upon; to restrain; to confine; to keep within bounds. To have as an element or subset.

farewell.desc: A wish of happiness or safety at parting, especially a permanent departure. A departure; the act of leaving. Parting, valedictory, final. Goodbye

interact.desc: To act upon each other. A short act or piece between others, as in a play; a break between acts. Intermediate employment or time. A pair or series of acts involving more than one person.

alone.desc: By oneself, solitary. Lacking peers who share one's beliefs, experiences, practices, etc. Apart from, or exclusive of, others. Mere; consisting of nothing further.

slate.desc: A flake or piece of certain types of stone that tend to cleave into thin layers. A fine-grained homogeneous sedimentary rock composed of clay or volcanic ash which has been metamorphosed so that it cleaves easily into thin layers. Having the bluish-grey colour of slate ''(noun )''. To scold (someone) harshly; to chastise, to excoriate, to lambaste.

easy.desc: Comfortable; at ease. Requiring little skill or effort. Causing ease; giving comfort, or freedom from care or labour. Free from constraint, harshness, or formality; unconstrained; smooth.

ascent.desc: The act of ascending; a motion upwards. The way or means by which one ascends. An eminence, hill, or high place. The degree of elevation of an object, or the angle it makes with a horizontal line; inclination; gradient; steepness

parking.desc: The action of the verb ''to park''. Space in which to park a car or other vehicle, such as a parking lot or curbside parking.

artery.desc: Any of the muscular- and elastic-walled blood vessels forming part of the circulation system by which blood is conveyed away from the heart regardless of its oxygenation status; see pulmonary artery. A major transit corridor in a system of roads, rivers, or railway lines.

talent.desc: A marked natural ability or skill. People of talent, viewed collectively; a talented person. One, especially a woman, from a particular place or area, judged by their attractiveness. A historical unit of weight and money used in ancient Greece, the Roman Empire and the Middle East, equal to about 30 to 60 kg in various times and places.

consolation.desc: The act or example of consoling; the condition of being consoled. The prize or benefit for the loser. A consolation goal.

carnival.desc: Any of a number of festivals held just before the beginning of Lent. A festive occasion marked by parades and sometimes special foods and other entertainment. A traveling amusement park, called a funfair in British English. A context in which transgression or inversion of the social order is given temporary license. Derived from the work of Mikhail Bakhtin.

wary.desc: Cautious of danger; carefully watching and guarding against deception, trickery, and dangers; suspiciously prudent Characterized by caution; guarded; careful; on one's guard thrifty, provident To curse, revile.

raise.desc: To cause to rise; to lift or elevate. To create, increase or develop. To establish contact with (e.g., by telephone or radio). To respond to a bet by increasing the amount required to continue in the hand.

tolerate.desc: To allow or permit without explicit approval, usually if it is perceived as negative. To bear, withstand.

completely.desc: In a complete manner; thoroughly. To the fullest extent or degree; totally.

offspring.desc: A person's daughter or son; a person's child. Any of a person's descendants, including of further generations. An animal or plant's progeny or young. Anything produced; the result of an entity's efforts.

struggle.desc: A contortion of the body in an attempt to escape or to perform a difficult task. Strife, contention, great effort. To strive, to labour in difficulty, to fight (''for'' or ''against''), to contend. To have difficulty with something.

ordeal.desc: A trial in which the accused was subjected to a dangerous test (such as ducking in water), divine authority deciding the guilt of the accused. A painful or trying experience. The poisonous ordeal bean or Calabar bean.

fate.desc: The presumed cause, force, principle, or divine will that predetermines events. The effect, consequence, outcome, or inevitable events predetermined by this cause. An event or a situation which is inevitable in the fullness of time. Destiny; ''often with a connotation of death, ruin, misfortune, etc.''

starvation.desc: A condition of severe suffering due to a lack of nutrition. Severe shortage of resources. A state where a process is perpetually denied necessary resources to process its work.

lively.desc: Full of life; energetic, vivacious. Bright, glowing, vivid; strong, vigorous. Endowed with or manifesting life; living. Representing life; lifelike.

modify.desc: To change part of. To be or become modified. To set bounds to; to moderate. To qualify the meaning of.

anxiety.desc: An unpleasant state of mental uneasiness, nervousness, apprehension and obsession or concern about some uncertain event. An uneasy or distressing desire (for something). Endeavor (to please). A state of restlessness and agitation, often accompanied by a distressing sense of oppression or tightness in the stomach. Any anxiety disorder, especially generalized anxiety disorder.

reasoning.desc: The deduction of inferences or interpretations from premises, abstract thought, ratiocination;  any instance of this, especially as a process leading to an action, motive. A Rastafari meeting held for the purposes of chanting, prayer and discussion.

satisfying.desc: That satisfies, gratifies or pleases; that removes any feeling of lack. Pleasing to certain  channels in , especially  and  ones  via .

assassinate.desc: To murder someone, especially an important person, by a sudden or obscure attack, especially for ideological or political reasons. To harm, ruin, or defame severely or destroy by treachery, slander, libel, or obscure attack. Assassination, murder. An assassin.

farmer.desc: Someone or something that , as: One who takes taxes, customs, excise, or other duties, to collect for a certain rate per cent. The lord of the field, or one who farms the lot and cope of the crown. A regular person; someone who did not receive a prestigious scholarship.

flair.desc: A natural or innate talent or aptitude. Distinctive style or elegance. Smell; odor. Olfaction; sense of smell.

technically.desc: Based on precise facts, which, however, may be contrary to common belief or casual terminology. Based on formal (de jure) arguments, which, however, may be misleading. In terms of technique. In a technical (involving specialized knowledge) way.

steering.desc: used to control direction; something used to steer.

propose.desc: To suggest a plan, course of action, etc. To ask for a person's hand in marriage. To intend. To talk; to converse.

crying.desc: That cries. That demands action or attention; desperate. That deserves rebuke or censure; deplorable. The act of one who cries; a weeping or shouting.

occasional.desc: Occurring or appearing irregularly from time to time, but not often; incidental. Created for a specific occasion. Intended for use as the occasion requires. Acting in the indicated role from time to time.

pop.desc: A loud, sharp sound, as of a cork coming out of a bottle, especially when the contents are pressurized by fizziness. An effervescent or fizzy drink, most frequently nonalcoholic; soda pop. A bottle, can, or serving of effervescent or fizzy drink, most frequently nonalcoholic; a soda pop. A : a quick, possibly unaimed, shot with a firearm.

acre.desc: An English unit of land area (symbol: '''a.''' or '''ac.''') originally denoting a day's ploughing for a yoke of oxen, now standardized as 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square metres. Any of various similar units of area in other systems. A wide expanse. A large quantity.

edit.desc: A change to the text of a document. A change in the text of a file, a website or the code of software. An edited piece of media, especially video footage. A compilation of memorable moments (in a show, sport, etc.), often featuring stylized camera effects and intense music.

inject.desc: To push or pump (something, especially fluids) into a cavity or passage. To introduce (something) suddenly or violently. To administer an injection to (someone or something), especially of medicine or drugs. To take or be administered something by means of injection, especially medicine or drugs.

complicated.desc: Difficult or convoluted. Folded longitudinally (as in the wings of certain insects).

chess.desc: A board game for two players, each beginning with sixteen chess pieces moving according to fixed rules across a chessboard with the objective to checkmate the opposing king. Any of several species of grass in the genus , generally considered weeds. One of the platforms, consisting of two or more planks dowelled together, for the flooring of a temporary military bridge.

interval.desc: A distance in space. A period of time. The difference (a ratio or logarithmic measure) in pitch between two notes, often referring to those two pitches themselves (otherwise known as a dyad). A connected section of the real line which may be empty or have a length of zero.

daring.desc: Adventurous, willing to take on or look for risks; overbold. Courageous or showing bravery; doughty. Racy; sexually provocative. Boldness.

photo.desc: A photograph. A photo finish. A digital picture of any kind. Photography

wisdom.desc: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise. A piece of wise advice. The discretionary use of knowledge for the greatest good. The ability to apply relevant knowledge in an insightful way, especially to different situations from that in which the knowledge was gained.

dancing.desc: The activity of taking part in a dance. A dance club in France.

add.desc: To join or unite (e.g. one thing to another, or as several particulars) so as to increase the number, augment the quantity or enlarge the magnitude, or so as to form into one aggregate. To sum up; to put together mentally; to add up. To combine elements of (something) into one quantity. To give by way of increased possession (to someone); to bestow (on).

upheaval.desc: The process of being heaved upward, especially the raising of part of the earth's crust. A disruptive change, from one state to another. A sudden violent upset, disruption or convulsion.

anything.desc: Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatsoever; a thing of any kind; something or other. Someone or something of importance. In any way, any extent or any degree.

divine.desc: Of or pertaining to a god. Eternal, holy, or otherwise godlike. Of superhuman or surpassing excellence. Beautiful, heavenly.

inclined.desc: At an angle to the horizontal; slanted or sloped. Having a tendency, preference, likelihood, or disposition.

mile.desc: The international mile: a unit of length precisely equal to 1.609344 kilometers established by treaty among Anglophone nations in 1959, divided into 5,280 feet or 1,760 yards. Any of several customary units of length derived from the 1593 English statute mile of 8 furlongs, equivalent to 5,280 feet or 1,760 yards of various precise values. Any of many customary units of length derived from the Roman mile (''mille passus'') of 8 stades or 5,000 Roman feet. The Scandinavian mile: a unit of length precisely equal to 10 kilometers defined in 1889.

row.desc: A line of objects, often regularly spaced, such as seats in a theatre, vegetable plants in a garden, etc. A horizontal line of entries in a table, etc., going from left to right, as opposed to a column going from top to bottom. . To propel (a boat or other craft) over water using oars.

compassionate.desc: Having, feeling or showing compassion (''to'' or ''toward'' someone). Given to someone as an exception because of a family emergency or a death in their family. furthermore.desc: In addition; besides; further; what's more (i.e. to denote additional information). ; the more especially forward, ahead or  progressed

collaborate.desc: To work together with others to achieve a common goal. To voluntarily cooperate treasonably, as with an enemy occupation force in one's country.

battlefield.desc: The area where a land battle is fought, which may not necessarily be a field.

presently.desc: Immediately, at once; quickly. Before long; soon. With actual presence; in actuality.

wreckage.desc: Something wrecked, especially the remains or debris of something which has been severely damaged or destroyed.

invitation.desc: The act of inviting; solicitation; the requesting of a person's company. A document or verbal message conveying an invitation. Allurement; enticement. A line that is intentionally left open to encourage the opponent to attack.

tangible.desc: ; able to be touched or felt; perceptible by the sense of touch. ; able to be perceived. Able to be treated as fact; real or concrete. by the mind; understandable.

begin.desc: To start, to initiate or take the first step into something. To come into existence. Beginning; start.

indispensable.desc: Absolutely necessary or requisite; that one cannot do without. , that cannot be set aside or ignored. To maintain or defend, as a cause or a claim, by words or measures; to vindicate a claim or title to. To insist on the legitimacy of one's rights, opinion, etc; not to allow oneself to be dismissed; to ensure that one is taken into consideration; to make oneself respected; to be assertive. See ''assert oneself''.

surface.desc: The external boundary of an object or body. The overside or upside of a flat object such as a table, or of a liquid. The outside hull of a tangible object. Outward or external appearance.

ham.desc: The region back of the knee joint; the popliteal space; the hock. A thigh and/or buttock of a hog slaughtered for meat; ''(occasionally)'' the corresponding cut from some other animal. Meat from the thigh and/or buttock of a hog cured for food. The back of the thigh of humans or certain other animals.

tenant.desc: One who holds a lease (a tenancy). One who has possession of any place. Any of a number of customers serviced through the same instance of an application. One who holds a feudal tenure in real property.

profoundly.desc: With depth, meaningfully. Very importantly. ; very; strongly or forcefully.

fortune.desc: Destiny, especially favorable. A prediction or set of predictions about a person's future provided by a fortune teller. A small slip of paper with wise or vaguely prophetic words printed on it, baked into a fortune cookie. The arrival of something in a sudden or unexpected manner; chance; accident.

strive.desc: To try to achieve a result; to make strenuous effort; to try earnestly and persistently. To struggle in opposition; to be in contention or dispute; to contend; to contest. To vie; to compete as a rival. .

verge.desc: A rod or staff of office, e.g. of a verger. An edge or border. The phallus. An old measure of land: a virgate or yardland.

hefty.desc: With heft; heavy, strong, vigorous, mighty, impressive Strong; bulky. Possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful; powerfully or heavily built. Heavy, weighing a lot.

manner.desc: Mode of action; way of performing or doing anything. Characteristic mode of acting or behaving; bearing. One's customary method of acting; habit. Good, polite behaviour.

overturn.desc: To turn over, capsize or upset. To overthrow or destroy. To reverse (a decision); to overrule or rescind. To diminish the significance of a previous defeat by winning; to make a comeback from.

reap.desc: To cut (for example a grain) with a sickle, scythe, or reaping machine. To gather (e.g. a harvest) by cutting. To obtain or receive as a reward, in a good or a bad sense. To terminate a child process that has previously exited, thereby removing it from the process table.

stereo.desc: A system of recording or reproducing sound that uses two or more channels, each playing a portion of the original sound at different locations in order to simulate the separation of sources along at least one spatial dimension. Any object or device equipped with audio components that reproduces sound in stereo, such as a stereo console in the home. A stereotype. A genre of Western-style pop and rock music.

partition.desc: An action which divides a thing into parts, or separates one thing from another. A part of something that has been divided. An approach to division in which one asks what the size of each part is, rather than (as in quotition) how many parts there are. The division of a territory into two or more autonomous ones.

abundance.desc: A large quantity; many. An overflowing fullness or ample sufficiency; profusion; copious supply; superfluity; plentifulness. Wealth; affluence; plentiful amount of resources. Frequency, amount, ratio of something within a given environment or sample.

scarce.desc: Uncommon, rare; difficult to find; insufficient to meet a demand. Scantily supplied (with); deficient (in); used with ''of''. Scarcely, only just.

weakness.desc: The condition of being weak. An inadequate quality; fault. A special fondness or obsessing desire.

sense.desc: Any of the manners by which living beings perceive the physical world: for humans sight, smell, hearing, touch, taste. Perception through the intellect; apprehension; awareness. Sound practical or moral judgment. The meaning, reason, or value of something.

note.desc: ''A symbol or annotation.'' ''A written or printed communication or commitment.'' ''A sound.'' An element of a scent, fragrance, or perfume, especially as a descriptor or category.

bold.desc: Courageous, daring. Visually striking; conspicuous. Having thicker strokes than the ordinary form of the typeface. Presumptuous, forward or impudent.

barrel.desc: A round () vessel, such as a cask, of greater length than breadth, and bulging in the middle, made of staves bound with hoops, and having flat ends (). The quantity which constitutes a full barrel: the volume or weight this represents varies by local law and custom. A solid drum, or a hollow cylinder or case A metallic tube, as of a gun, from which a projectile is discharged.

disadvantage.desc: A weakness or undesirable characteristic; con; drawback. A setback or handicap. Loss; detriment; hindrance. To place at a disadvantage.

insulting.desc: Containing insult, or having the intention of insulting. The act of giving insult.

speculate.desc: To think, meditate or reflect on a subject; to consider, to deliberate or cogitate. To make an inference based on inconclusive evidence; to surmise or conjecture. To make a risky trade in the hope of making a profit; to venture or gamble. To anticipate which branch of code will be chosen and execute it in advance.

pace.desc: A step. A way of stepping. Speed or velocity in general. A measure of the hardness of a pitch and of the tendency of a cricket ball to maintain its speed after bouncing.

occasionally.desc: On occasion: at relatively infrequent intervals, from time to time, sometimes. On an occasion, accidentally, by chance. On the occasion of something else happening; incidentally, by the way.

dire.desc: Warning of bad consequences: ill-boding; portentous. Requiring action to prevent bad consequences: urgent, pressing. Expressing bad consequences: dreadful; dismal. Bad in quality, awful, terrible.

deny.desc: To disallow or reject. To assert that something is not true. To refuse to give or grant something to someone. To take something away from someone; to deprive of.

rap.desc: A sharp blow with something hard. The blame for something. A casual talk. Rap music.

lodge.desc: A building for recreational use such as a hunting lodge or a summer cabin. A local chapter of some fraternities, such as freemasons. A local chapter of a trade union. A rural hotel or resort, an inn.

formidable.desc: Causing fear, dread, awe, or discouragement as a result of size, strength, or some other impressive feature; commanding respect; causing wonder or astonishment. Difficult to defeat or overcome.

emblem.desc: A representative symbol, such as a trademark, a badge or logo. Something that represents a larger whole. Inlay; inlaid or mosaic work; something ornamental inserted in a surface. A picture accompanied with a motto, a set of verses, etc. intended as a moral lesson or meditation.

injustice.desc: of justice; unjustice. of the rights of another person or people. Unfairness; the state of not being fair or just.

privilege.desc: An exemption from certain laws granted by the Pope. A particular benefit, advantage, or favor; a right or immunity enjoyed by some but not others; a prerogative, preferential treatment. An especially rare or fortunate opportunity; the good fortune (to do something). The fact of being privileged; the status or existence of (now especially social or economic) benefit or advantage within a given society.

conditioning.desc: The process of modifying a person or animal's behaviour. Any preparation or training, especially athletic training of the body. The storage of a material specimen under specified temperature, humidity for a specified time prior to testing.

downfall.desc: A precipitous decline in fortune; death or rapid deterioration, as in status or wealth. The cause of such a fall; a critical blow or error. An act of falling down. To fall down; deteriorate; decline.

occur.desc: To happen or take place. To present or offer itself. To come or be presented to the mind; to suggest itself. To be present or found.

adult.desc: An animal that is full-grown. A person who has reached the legal age of majority. Fully grown. Intended for or restricted to adults rather than children due to size, maturity, knowledge level, judgement, etc.

ostensibly.desc: , apparently, on the surface; supposedly, according to representations or implications made by someone (especially when their motives are suspected by others).

flood.desc: An overflow of a large amount of water (usually disastrous) from a lake or other body of water due to excessive rainfall or other input of water. A large number or quantity of anything appearing more rapidly than can easily be dealt with. The flowing in of the tide, opposed to the ebb. A floodlight.

permission.desc: authorisation; consent (especially formal consent from someone in authority) The act of permitting. Flags or access control lists pertaining to a file that dictate who can access it, and how. To grant or obtain authorization for.

facade.desc: The face of a building, especially the front view or elevation. The face or front (most visible side) of any other thing, such as the prospect of an organ. A deceptive or insincere outward appearance. An object serving as a simplified interface to a larger body of code, as in the facade pattern.

sauce.desc: A liquid (often thickened) condiment or accompaniment to food. Tomato sauce (similar to US tomato ketchup), as in: Alcohol, booze. Vitality; capability or talent.
